text: Situation Report
translation: 情况报告

text: <cr>On the 22nd of June 1941, the invasion of the Soviet Union began, opening up the Eastern Front and committing Germany to a two front war. The Axis Powers offensive, invading along a 2,900-kilometer front that stretched from the Arctic Ocean in the North to the Black Sea in the South, saw the greatest invasion force ever known to mankind: around 3.8 million men, supported by around 600,000 vehicles and 600,000 horses.<cr>At the start of the invasion, 80% of the available Soviet military forces in the West had been deployed on the border that faced Axis territories as the first strategic echelon. The deployment of the remaining 20% was along the Dvina and Dnieper Rivers as the second echelon and was meant to serve as a spearhead to the Soviet counteroffensive in case of a German invasion.<cr>At the time of the invasion, the Red Army was in the process of reorganisation and modernisation. Its capabilities were greatly reduced from the Purges of the 1930s, strongly affecting the quality of the officer corps. Moreover the standing and morale of the Red Army had been shaken as a result of the Winter War with Finland. On the other hand, after the successful campaigns that had brought Europe to its knees, the German Wehrmacht had consolidated itself as an experienced army, with good training, organisation, and an excellent officer corps.<cr> The titanic struggle between the two major powers and their conflicting ideologies has just begun and it will only end when one of them has been completely destroyed.
translation: <cr>1941年6月22日，入侵苏联的行动开始，开启了东线战场，并使德国陷入两面作战的局面。轴心国势力在从北极洋到黑海长达2,900公里的战线上发动攻势，这是人类历史上规模最大的一次入侵：约380万士兵，配有约60万辆车辆和60万匹马。<cr>在入侵开始时，苏联西部可调动军事力量中有80%被部署在面向轴心国领土的边境上作为第一战略梯队。剩余20%的部队则沿多瓦纳河和第聂伯河布署为第二梯队，准备在德国发动进攻的情况下成为苏军反攻的尖刀。<cr>入侵时，红军正处于重组和现代化的过程中。其能力因1930年代的大清洗而大大削弱，严重影响了军官队伍的质量。此外，与芬兰的冬季战争也动摇了红军的士气。另一方面，在成功地将欧洲拖入泥潭后，德国国防军已经巩固为一支经验丰富的军队，训练、组织良好，并拥有优秀的军官队伍。<cr>两大强国及其对立意识形态之间的这场巨大力量较量才刚刚开始，只有当其中一方被彻底消灭时才会结束。

text: The Allies capture the island of Corsica after a landing by the French I Corps. German forces in the island successfully evacuate to mainland Italy via the port of Bastia, leaving behind 700 dead and 350 POWs.<cr>During his visit to Corsica, General de Gaulle praises the effort and sacrifices the Corsican people have made. For the islands inhabitants the Liberation does not mean peace, but rather a return to war alongside the Allies. 12,000 Corsicans between the ages of 20 and 28 are mobilized. Furthermore, the region starts being used as a naval and air base to control maritime connections and as a base for attacks against Central and Northern Italy, which are still held by the Germans. <cr><cr>- Corsica region captured by the Allies

translation: 盟军在安济奥登陆，作为掷弹兵行动的一部分，德军部队移动到海滩头周围的防御圈内。西方盟国加强了对卡西诺防线的攻击。意大利空军战斗强度增加至高（4）

text: Gothic Line
translation: 古达奇防线

text: With many Allied forces diverted to efforts in France and facing the Gothic Line, combat intensity in Italy decreases. <cr><cr>- Italy TB air combat intensity decreases to MEDIUM (3)
translation: 随着许多盟军部队被调往法国和面对哥特防线的作战，意大利战场上的战斗强度下降。<cr><cr>- 意大利TB空中战斗强度降至中等（3）

text: Advance into Northern Italy
translation: 进军北意大利

text: The Allies advance into Northern Italy. The final Allied offensive in Italy begins. <cr><cr>- Italy TB ground combat increases to HIGH (4) <cr>- Italy TB air combat increases to HIGH (4)
translation: 盟军挺进北意大利。在意大利的最后一次攻势开始。<cr>指挥官报告：意大利战场地面战斗强度提升至高（4）<cr>指挥官报告：意大利战场空中战斗强度提升至高（4）

text: Italian Campaign Concluded
translation: 意大利战役结束

text: German forces in Northern Italy surrender. The Italian Campaign ends.<cr><cr>- Italy Theater Box is now inactive<cr>- Many Axis forces surrender, the rest evacuate to Axis Reserve<cr>- Game Event Austria on the Frontline set to Active
translation:
德国在北意大利的部队投降。意大利战役结束。
- 意大利战区盒现在不活跃
- 许多轴心国部队投降，其余部队撤退至轴心国预备队
- 游戏事件奥地利前线设为活跃

text: COMBAT INTENSITY: NORWAY
translation: 战斗强度：挪威

text: Soviets Advance into Norway
translation: 苏军挺进挪威

text: Soviets advance into Norway. <cr><cr>- Norway TB ground combat intensity increases to LOW (2)<cr>- Norway TB air combat intensity increases to LOW (2) <cr>- Northern Front TB ground combat intensity set to LOW (2) <cr>- Northern Front TB air combat intensity set to LOW (2)
translation: 苏军进入挪威。<cr><cr>- 挪威战区地面战斗强度降低至低（2）<cr>- 挪威战区空中战斗强度降低至低（2） <cr>- 北方方面军战区地面战斗强度设为低（2） <cr>- 北方方面军战区空中战斗强度设为低（2）

text: COMBAT INTENSITY: BALKANS
translation: 战斗强度：巴尔干战役

text: Yugoslav Royalists Advance
translation: 南斯拉夫王党势力推进

text: Yugoslav Royalists advance on Sarajevo. The largest anti-German offensive in the Balkans, during the war. <cr><cr>- Balkans TB ground combat intensity increases to LOW (2) <cr>- Balkans TB air combat intensity increases to VERY LOW (1)
translation: 南斯拉夫流亡政府部队向萨拉热窝推进。这是战时巴尔干地区规模最大的反德攻势。<cr>指令：巴尔干战区地面战斗强度降低至低（2）<cr>指令：巴尔干战区空中战斗强度降低至极低（1）

text: SU Offensive on Belgrade
translation: 苏军进攻贝尔格莱德

text: Soviet army enters Serbia and launches an offensive on Belgrade in conjunction with operations of Yugoslav partisans. <cr><cr>- Balkans TB air combat intensity increases to LOW (2)<cr>- Game Event Mainland Greece Liberated set to Active and event Date set to 17 days from the current date<cr>- Game Event Belgrade Liberated set to Active and event Date set to 21 days from the current date
translation: Soviet army enters Serbia and launches an offensive on Belgrade in conjunction with operations of Yugoslav partisans. <cr><cr>- Balkans TB air combat intensity increases to LOW (2)<cr>- Game Event Mainland Greece Liberated set to Active and event Date set to 17 days from the current date<cr>- Game Event Belgrade Liberated set to Active and event Date set to 21 days from the current date

text: Belgrade Liberated
translation: 贝尔格莱德解放

text: Belgrade liberated from the Germans by a joint effort of the Soviet Red Army, Yugoslav Partisans and the Bulgarian Peoples Army. Although most of the liberated territory is returned to Yugoslavian control, Soviet forces are able to utilize the rail lines to help supply the fighting in Hungary. <cr><cr>- Balkans TB ground combat intensity reduced to VERY LOW (1) <cr>- Balkans TB air combat intensity reduced to VERY LOW (1) <cr>- Serbia region captured by the Soviets<cr>- Game Event Macedonia under SU Control set to Active and event Date set to 30 days from the current date<cr>- Game Event Albania under SU Control set to Active and event Date set to 37 days from the current date<cr>- Game Event Montenegro Liberated set to Active and event Date set to 52 days from the current date<cr>- Game Event Bosnia & Herzegovina Liberated set to Active and event Date set to 185 days from the current date<cr>- Game Event Dalmatia Liberated set to Active and event Date set to 14 days from the current date
translation: 贝尔格莱德被苏联红军、南斯拉夫游击队和保加利亚人民军联合解放。尽管大部分解放领土归还给南斯拉夫控制，苏军仍能利用铁路线支援在匈牙利的战斗。<cr>巴尔干 TB 地面战强度降低至非常低（1）<cr>巴尔干 TB 空中战强度降低至非常低（1）<cr>塞尔维亚地区被苏军占领<cr>游戏事件：马其顿在苏联控制下设为激活，事件日期设定为当前日期后30天<cr>游戏事件：阿尔巴尼亚在苏联控制下设为激活，事件日期设定为当前日期后37天<cr>游戏事件：黑山解放设为激活，事件日期设定为当前日期后52天<cr>游戏事件：波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那解放设为激活，事件日期设定为当前日期后185天<cr>游戏事件：达尔马提亚解放设为激活，事件日期设定为当前日期后14天

text: COMBAT INTENSITY: WE
translation: 战斗强度：我方主导

text: Germany Fully Mobilizes
translation: 德国全面动员

text: Having lost hundreds of thousands of men in the Normandy fighting, and facing Allied armies sweeping across France, Germany orders full mobilization of its available manpower. Many Luftwaffe and naval personnel are quickly transferred to the ground forces, while additional men are called up for military duty. This manpower is insufficiently trained in ground combat operations.<cr><cr>- 200,000 men are added to the German manpower pool<cr>- German manpower multiplier is increased by 4<cr>- German Ground National Morale is reduced by 2
translation: 在诺曼底战斗中损失了数十万士兵，并面临盟军横扫法国的威胁，德国下令全面动员可用的人力资源。许多空军和海军人员迅速转入地面部队，同时还有更多人被征召入伍。这些人对地面作战操作训练不足。<cr>增援：- 向德国人力池增加200,000名士兵<cr>- 德国人力乘数增加4<cr>- 德国地面国民士气降低2

text: More Men For The Ground Forces
translation: 更多地面部队人员

text: Ongoing heavy losses in the east, and realization that the war would not end anytime soon, force steps to make more men available for the ground forces. Luftwaffe and Kriegsmarine manpower are shifted to the ground forces. Additional men are freed up from industry.<cr><cr>- German manpower multiplier is increased by 12
translation: 东线持续的重大损失，以及战争不会很快结束的现实，迫使采取措施使更多人员可供地面部队使用。空军和海军的人力被转移到地面部队。工业中释放出额外人员。<cr><cr>- 德国人力乘数增加12

text: Air Offensive in WE
translation: 西方空袭攻势

text: Allies begin air attacks on Europe. <cr><cr>- Western Europe TB air combat increases to MEDIUM (3)
translation: 盟军开始对欧洲发动空袭。<cr><cr> - 西欧的TB空中战斗强度增加至中等(3)

text: D-Day
translation: 登陆日

text: Allies land in Normandy. Italy is no longer the site of the only major ground combat in Western Europe.<cr><cr>- Western Europe TB ground combat intensity increases to VERY HIGH (5) <cr>- Western Europe TB air combat intensity increases to VERY HIGH (5)<cr>- Italy TB Ground Requirement decreases to 195, Air to 7
translation:
盟军在诺曼底登陆。意大利不再是西欧唯一主要地面战场。
- 西欧地面战斗强度增加至非常高（5）
- 西欧空中战斗强度增加至非常高（5）
- 意大利地面需求减少到195，空中需求减少到7

text: Disaster in the West
translation: 西线灾变

text: Having broken the German line in Normandy, the Allies form the Falaise pocket and then race across France. The Allies take the Channel ports, central and eastern France. Allies invade southern France. <cr><cr>- Roughly 20% of German ground forces in the Western Europe TB surrender<cr>- Western Europe TB ground combat intensity decreases to HIGH (4)<cr>- Western Europe TB Ground Requirement decreases to 550<cr>- Norway TB Ground Requirement decreases to 75<cr>- Balkans TB Ground Requirement decreases to 130
translation: 突破了诺曼底的德国防线后，盟军在法莱斯形成了包围圈，并迅速横扫法国。盟军占领了海峡港口、法国中部和东部地区。盟军入侵南法。<cr><cr>约20%的驻西欧德军投降<cr><cr>西欧战区地面战斗强度降至高（4）<cr><cr>西欧战区地面需求减少至550<cr><cr>挪威战区地面需求减少至75<cr><cr>巴尔干战区地面需求减少至130

text: Axis Ardennes Offensive
translation: 轴心国阿登攻势

text: Germans launch the counteroffensive against the allies in the Ardennes area. <cr><cr>- Western Europe TB ground combat intensity increases to VERY HIGH (5)
translation: 德军在阿登地区对盟军发起反攻。<cr><cr>：西欧战区地面战斗强度增至非常高（5）

text: Air Offensive Intensifies
translation: 空中攻势加强

text: Air missions soar as the Allies prep Western Europe for D-Day.<cr><cr>- Western Europe TB air combat intensity increases to HIGH (4)
translation: 盟军加紧准备西欧的D日，空中任务频仍。<cr><cr>- 西欧战区的空战强度提升至高（4）

text: Failure in the Ardennes
translation: 阿登地区失败

text: The German offensive in the Ardennes is halted short of the Meuse River. The offensive is called off and German forces retreat back to the German frontier.<cr><cr>- Western Europe TB ground combat intensity set to HIGH (4)
translation: 德国在阿登地区的进攻在距离默兹河不远处受阻。攻势被叫停，德军撤退回到德国边境。<cr>指挥官报告: 西欧战场地面战斗强度设为高（4）

text: Crossing the Rhine
translation: 渡过莱茵河

text: After pushing the Germans back to their Ardennes Offensive start lines, Allied armies begin the final offensive to breach the Rhine and overrun Western Germany.<cr><cr>- Western Europe TB ground combat intensity set to VERY HIGH (5)
translation: 在将德国军队推回到他们在阿登攻势开始时的位置后，盟军开始了最后的进攻，以突破莱茵河并占领西德。<cr>西方欧洲TB地面战斗强度设置为非常高(5)

text: COMBAT INTENSITY: SU GARRISON
translation: 战斗强度：苏守备部队

text: Soviet Partisans Active
translation: 苏联游击队活跃

text: German security forces begin to clash with Soviet partisans, beginning a several year campaign to secure the German rear area.<cr><cr>- Soviet Union Garrison TB ground combat intensity set to VERY LOW (1)
translation: 德国治安部队开始与苏联游击队发生冲突，开始了几年的战役以确保德国后方的安全。<cr><cr> - 苏联守备部队地面战斗强度设置为非常低（1）

text: Partisans Under Stavka
translation: 游击队受最高统帅部指挥

text: By May 30, 1942, the Partisan Movement becomes centrally controlled and supplied by Stavka. More than 2,000 partisan detachments (over 90,000 personnel) are now under Soviet control. Highly coordinated partisan activity escalates. <cr><cr>- Soviet Union Garrison TB ground combat intensity increases to LOW (2)
translation: 截至1942年5月30日，游击队运动开始由最高统帅部大本营中央控制和供应。超过2,000支游击小分队（共计逾9万人）现在处于苏联的掌控之下。高度协调的游击活动升级。<cr><cr>- 苏联守备部队地面战斗强度增加至低级（2）

text: Soviet Partisan War Ends
translation: 苏联游击战争结束

text: With the bulk of the Soviet Union liberated, the Partisan Movement comes to an end. Many of the partisan formations are obsorbed into the Soviet army. <cr><cr>- Soviet Union Garrison TB is now inactive.<cr>- Axis forces in the Soviet Union Garrison TB moved to Axis Reserve<cr>- 250,000 men added to the Soviet manpower pool<cr>- Game Event Soviet Partisans set to Inactive
translation: 随着苏联大部分领土获得解放，游击运动宣告结束。许多游击队编制被并入苏军。<cr>- 苏联守备部队编制表现已失效。<cr>- 轴心国在苏联的守备部队编制表移至轴心国预备状态<cr>- 向苏联人力资源池增加25万人<cr>- 游击队事件设为无效<cr>

text: Forced Reorganization
translation: 强制重组

text: In the early weeks of the war, it quickly became apparent that the Soviet command structure needed to change. The Corps HQs did not function well, and this was compounded by the large early losses in the border armies. The Soviet Army just didn't have the number of trained staff officers needed to man these formations effectively.<cr><cr>- As part of a major reorganization of Soviet ground forces, most Soviet rifle and mechanized Corps HQs will disband automatically or upgrade to Army HQs in the coming turns, many without notice.
translation: 在战争初期几周内，很快就显现出苏联指挥体系需要改变。军部未能有效运作，而且由于边境集团军早期的巨大损失，情况更加恶化。苏军缺乏足够的训练有素的参谋军官来充实这些部队。<cr>指挥官报告：作为对苏军地面部队进行的重大重组的一部分，在接下来的回合中，大多数步兵师和机械化军部将自动解散或升级为集团军部，许多情况下不会发出通知。

text: Temp Mobilizaton Measures End
translation: 临时动员措施结束

text: Temporary measures taken to make more men available for the ground forces are ended.<cr><cr>- German manpower multiplier is reduced by 12
translation: 临时增加地面部队人员的措施结束。<cr><cr>- 德国征兵倍率减少12

text: SOVIET APs
translation: 苏联行政点

text: Cav Corps and Ski Bn's
translation: 骑兵军和滑雪营

text: In preparation for launching a winter counterattack, Soviets begin forming Cavalry Corps and build additional ski forces. <cr><cr>- Soviets gain 150 AP
translation: 为发动冬季反攻，苏联开始组建骑兵军并加强滑雪部队。<cr><cr> - 苏联获得150行政点

text: Rifle Corps
translation: 步兵军

text: Soviets reorganize and begin forming new Rifle Corps.<cr><cr>- Soviets gain 100 AP
translation: 苏军重组并开始组建新的步兵军。<cr><cr>- 苏联获得100行政点

text: Tank Corps
translation: 坦克军

text: Soviets restructure tank forces and begin to form Tank Corps. <cr><cr>- Soviets gain 150 AP
translation: 苏联重组坦克部队并开始组建坦克军。<cr><cr> - 苏联获得150行政点

text: Mechanized Corps
translation: 机械化军

text: Soviets create a new combined arms unit, the Mechanized Corps.<cr><cr>- Soviets gain 100 AP
translation: 苏联创建了一个新的诸兵种合成部队，机械化军。<cr><cr> - 苏联获得100行政点

text: Artillery Divisions
translation:
炮兵师division在此处指代特定部队类型，但根据术语应翻译为：
炮兵单位

考虑到术语的一致性及上下文的准确性，此处更正为：
炮兵师

text: Soviets invent a fearsome new formation, the Artillery Division, and continue army reorganization in order to prepare for a fall/winter counteroffensive.<cr><cr>- Soviets gain 100 AP
translation: 苏联发明了一种可怕的新型编制——炮兵师，并继续进行集团军重组，以准备秋季/冬季反攻。<cr> <cr> - 苏联获得100行政点

text: Soviets Reorg Continues
translation: 苏军重组继续进行

text: In anticipation of going over to strategic offensive in the summer of 1943, the Soviets continue to reorganize and upgrade their army.<cr><cr>- Soviets gain 100 AP
translation: 为夏季1943年转入战略进攻做准备，苏联继续重组和升级其军队。<cr>获得100行政点<cr>

text: Defend the Motherland!
translation: 保卫祖国！

text: With the struggle unending, and Axis armies poised to continue their movement east, the Soviet Union reacts with a massive mobilization and training of manpower. Additional manpower reserves are rushed into action to increase the forces facing the Axis juggernaut.<cr><cr> - 450,000 men added to the Soviet manpower pool
translation: 随着战斗不断，轴心国军队准备继续向东推进，苏联作出反应，进行大规模动员和训练。额外的人力资源被迅速投入行动，以增强对抗轴心国巨无霸的力量。<cr>新增450,000人加入苏联人力储备

text: Soviets Release Reserves
translation: 苏军释放预备部队

text: As Soviet forces mobilized in the Fall of 1941, Stavka insisted on keeping large reserves in anticipation of a winter counteroffensive. Although some reserves were released in late November, most did not arrive at the front until December.<cr><cr> - 500,000 men added to the Soviet manpower pool
translation: 随着苏联部队在1941年秋季动员，最高统帅部坚持保留大量预备队，以备冬季反攻。尽管一些预备队在11月下旬被释放，但大多数直到12月才抵达方面军。<cr>增援：- 增加50万苏联兵力

text: Additional Reserves Released
translation: 额外预备部队释放

text: In anticipation of the coming Summer campaigning season, Stavka releases additional reserve manpower for the front.<cr><cr> - 150,000 men added to the Soviet manpower pool
translation: 为迎接即将到来的夏季战役季节，最高统帅部大本营释放额外的预备人员到方面军。<cr><cr> - 向苏联人力池增加150,000人

text: STRATEGIC BOMBING CAMPAIGN
translation: 战略轰炸战役

text: RAF Raids 1941
translation: 英空军1941年空袭

text: The British RAF begins conducting bombing raids on Axis cities in July 1941 which stretch until December 1941. These early bombing missions reveal that only one-in-three bombers are able to hit their mark within 5 miles of their target. <cr><cr>- Target: Manpower <cr>- Damage 20, Radius 55, Raids 1
translation: 1941年7月，英国皇家空军开始对轴心国城市进行轰炸，一直持续到12月。这些早期的轰炸任务显示，只有三分之一的轰炸机能够在距离目标5英里的范围内命中目标。<cr>任务：人力<cr>伤害：20，半径：55，袭击次数：1

text: RAF Raids 1942
translation: RAF 空袭 1942 年

text: By early Spring of 1942, larger size raids (1,000 bombers per raid) start being conducted over Germany and other Axis territory. During this year, bombing strategies and tactics start evolving, including changes such as the Area Bombing Directive, the Bomber Stream and the Master Bomber Tactic. An increasing amount of new bombing systems, ordinance and aircraft are incorporated into the bombing campaign. Among these are the Gee radio navigation system, the 8,000 lb Blockbuster bomb and B-17 aircraft. <cr><cr>- Target: Manpower <cr>- Damage 40, Radius 50, Raids 1
translation: 1942年早春，规模更大的空袭（每次袭击使用1000架轰炸机）开始在德国和其他轴心国领土上进行。这一年中，轰炸策略和战术开始演变，包括区域轰炸指令、轰炸机编队和主轰炸机战术等变化。越来越多的新轰炸系统、弹药和飞机被纳入轰炸行动之中，其中包括Gee无线电导航系统、8000磅的Blockbuster炸弹以及B-17飞机。<cr>目标：人力<cr>破坏：40，半径50，袭击次数1

text: RAF Raids 1943
translation: 英空军袭击 1943年

text: During 1943, American USAAF medium and heavy bombers begin hitting the Axis during the day in relentless bombing raids, while the British continue to use their expertise in radar and night actions to keep the fight going during the critical night-time hours allowing the enemy no time to rest and recover. <cr><cr>- Target: Manpower <cr>- Damage 60, Radius 50, Raids 1
translation: 在1943年，美国陆军航空队的中型和重型轰炸机开始在白天对轴心国进行无情的空袭，而英国人则继续利用他们在雷达技术和夜间行动方面的专长，在关键的夜晚时段保持战斗，不让敌人有休息和恢复的时间。<cr><cr>- 目标：人力 <cr>- 损伤60，半径50，袭击次数1

text: RAF Long Range Raids 1943
translation: 1943年英军远程空袭

text: In 1943 the RAF launches large long-range bombing missions over much of occupied Europe. <cr><cr>- Target: Manpower <cr>- Damage 30, Radius 65, Raids 1
translation: 1943年，英国皇家空军对被占领的欧洲进行了大规模远程轰炸任务。<cr><cr>- 目标：人力 <cr>- 损失30%，半径65，袭击次数1

text: 8th AF Raids early 1943
translation: 第八航空队1943年初空袭

text: The US 8th Air Force conducts multiple large bomber raids against Axis railyards and heavy industry areas. These raids involve around 300 to 400 bombers. The most significant of them is the 5 month long bombing campaign of the German Ruhr industry complex. The effect of this campaign is a severe reduction in the production of steel and armaments. <cr><cr>- Target: Railyard <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 40, Raids 1 <cr><cr>- Target: Heavy Industry <cr>- Damage 50, Radius 40, Raids 1
translation:
美国第8航空队对轴心国的铁路枢纽和重工业区进行了多次大规模轰炸行动。这些袭击涉及大约300到400架轰炸机。其中最重要的是针对德国鲁尔工业区长达5个月的空袭行动，导致钢铁和武器生产大幅下降。
- 目标：铁路枢纽 <cr>
- 损失：100%，半径：40，袭击次数：1
- 目标：重工业区 <cr>
- 损失：50%，半径：40，袭击次数：1

text: 8th AF Raids late 1943
translation: 第八航空队晚秋袭击

text: During the 2nd half of 1943 the US 8th AF continues its massive 1,000 bomber raids on German industries. Most significant are the August to December raids on the German aircraft industry. 5,092 tons of explosives are dropped on 14 targeted aircraft plants (mostly airframe plants). Production of single-engine fighters (Bf 109s and Fw 190s) drops by 45%.<cr>The Americans take heavy losses in their raid in August against Regensburg and Schweinfurt, losing 60 planes and 664 crewmen KIA or POW. A later attack of the ball bearing plants around Schweinfurt in October also causes heavy losses, with the Americans losing 60 aircraft with 600 crewmen KIA or POW. These losses amount to 25% of the attacking force. <cr><cr>- Target: Heavy Industry <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 55, Raids 1 <cr><cr>- Target: Airframe <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 50, Raids 1 <cr><cr>- Target: Railyard <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 50, Raids 1
translation:
在1943年下半年，美国第8航空队继续对德国工业进行大规模的千架轰炸机袭击。其中最重要的是从八月到十二月针对德国飞机制造业的一系列空袭。共投下了5,092吨炸弹，目标是14家主要生产机身的飞机工厂。单引擎战斗机（Bf 109和Fw 190）的产量下降了45%。

在8月份对雷根斯堡和施韦因富特的袭击中，美国损失惨重，60架飞机被击落或俘获，共有664名机组人员阵亡或成为战俘。随后在10月针对施韦因富特周边轴承工厂的一次攻击也造成了重大损失，美军损失了60架飞机和600名机组人员（阵亡或成为战俘）。这些损失占到了袭击力量的25%。

- 目标：重工业
- 损坏程度：100%，半径：55，空袭次数：1

- 目标：机身制造厂
- 损坏程度：100%，半径：50，空袭次数：1

- 目标：铁路编组站
- 损坏程度：100%，半径：50，空袭次数：1

text: 9th AF Raids 1943
translation: 第九航空队1943年空袭

text: From airfields in Libya, the US 9th AF conducts bombing raids on the refineries in and around Ploeasti (Rumania) as part of Operation Tidal Wave with the goal of denying petroleum-based fuel to the Axis powers. The Americans lose 53 aircraft and 660 air crewmen in the operation, one of the costliest major Allied air raids of the war. The mission fails to curtail fuel production output. <cr><cr>- Target: Fuel <cr>- Damage 25, Radius 115, Raids 3 <cr><cr>- Target: Railyard <cr>- Damage 25, Radius 115, Raids 3
translation:
从利比亚的机场，美国第9航空队执行代号为“浪潮行动”的轰炸任务，目标是罗马尼亚普洛耶什蒂地区的炼油厂，旨在切断轴心国获取石油基燃料的途径。此次行动中，美军损失了53架飞机和660名空勤人员，成为二战中最昂贵的重大盟军空中袭击之一。该任务未能遏制燃料生产。

- 目标：燃料
- 损失 25%，半径 115 公里，袭击次数 3

- 目标：火车站
- 损失 25%，半径 115 公里，袭击次数 3

text: RAF Long Range Raids 1945
translation: 1945年英军远程空袭

text: Allied Bombing Increases
translation: 盟军轰炸增强

text: First American daylight raids on occupied Europe begin in June of 1942. German air defenses increased in July to combat the growing intensity of the allied bombing campaign. <cr><cr>- Western Europe TB Air Defense Requirement increases to 85<cr>- Western Europe TB Night Air Defense Requirement increases to 59
translation: First American daylight raids on occupied Europe begin in June of 1942. German air defenses increased in July to combat the growing intensity of the allied bombing campaign. <cr><cr>- Western Europe TB Air Defense Requirement increases to 85<cr>- Western Europe TB Night Air Defense Requirement increases to 59

text: Escorts Arrive Over Germany

text: Allied short-to-medium range fighters (P-47s) begin escorting bomber groups on raids over occupied Europe. Presence of allied escort fighters forces Germany to expand its air defenses.<cr><cr>- Western Europe TB Air Defense Requirement increases to 150<cr>- Western Europe TB Night Air Defense Requirement increases to 80
translation:
盟军的中短程战斗机（P-47）开始护航轰炸机编队对被占领的欧洲进行空袭。盟军护航战斗机的存在迫使德国扩大其防空力量。
- 西欧TB防空需求增加至150
- 西欧TB夜间防空需求增加至80

text: Battle of Berlin
translation: 柏林会战

text: The RAF's 'Battle of Berlin' campaign begins in the latter part of 1943 and continues into the spring of 1944. The campaign targets other german cities as well, to prevent the concentration of defenses in Berlin. Germany is forced to increase its air defenses. <cr><cr>- Western Europe TB Air Defense Requirement increases to 200<cr>- Western Europe TB Night Air Defense Requirement increases to 95
translation: 英国皇家空军的“柏林战役”于1943年下半年开始，并持续到1944年春天。该行动还针对其他德国城市，以防止柏林集中防御力量。德国被迫加强其防空力量。<cr>西欧TB防空需求增加至200<cr>西欧TB夜间防空需求增加至95

text: P-51s In Action
translation: P-51参战

text: Spring of 1944 introduces new long range fighters (P-51s) which are able to escort bomber groups all the way to their targets and back. The new fighters are powerful enough to engage the best of the Luftwaffe air forces. By mid-year, Germany reorganizes its Luftwaffe forces and ground air defenses to meet the new threat. <cr><cr>- Western Europe TB Air Defense Requirement increases to 270<cr>- Western Europe TB Night Air Defense Requirement decreases to 75
translation: Spring of 1944 introduces new long range fighters (P-51s) which are able to escort bomber groups all the way to their targets and back. The new fighters are powerful enough to engage the best of the Luftwaffe air forces. By mid-year, Germany reorganizes its Luftwaffe forces and ground air defenses to meet the new threat. <cr><cr>- Western Europe TB Air Defense Requirement increases to 270<cr>- Western Europe TB Night Air Defense Requirement decreases to 75

text: Final Effort
translation: 最后的努力

text: Germany desperately tries to gain air superiority with their diminishing air forces by conducting air campaigns like Operation Bodenplatte (Baseplate), during the stagnant stage of the Battle of the Bulge. <cr><cr>- Western Europe TB Air Defense Requirement increases to 300
translation: 德国竭力通过执行“基地板”行动等空中战役来获得制空权，尽管其空军力量正在减弱。在突出部战役的僵持阶段尤其如此。<cr>西欧TB防空需求增加至300

text: Winter Is Here
translation: 寒冬已至

text: Facing harsh winter conditions in the Soviet Union, forces are freed up in the west. However, increasing partisan activities require additional rear area security.<cr><cr>- Western Europe TB Ground Requirement decreases to 345<cr>- Soviet Union Garrison TB Ground Requirement increases to 90
translation:
面对苏联严酷的冬季条件，西部地区可以释放部分兵力。然而，游击活动日益增加，需要加强后方地区的治安力量。
<cr><cr>- 西欧地面部队需求减少至345
<cr>- 苏联守备部队地面部队需求增加至90

text: Dieppe Raid
translation: 迪耶普突袭作战

text: In the wake of the Dieppe Raid, additional forces are required to face the threat in the West.<cr><cr>- Western Europe TB Ground Requirement increases to 475
translation: 在迪耶普突袭之后，需要增派部队以应对西线威胁。<cr>西方欧洲地面兵力需求增加至475

text: What's Next?
translation: 接下来是什么？

text: With the fall of North Africa, the Axis prepare for the next Allied move.<cr><cr>- Western Europe TB Ground Requirement increases to 530<cr>- Italy TB Ground Requirement increases to 230, Air to 70<cr>- Balkans TB Ground Requirement increases to 160, Air to 11
translation:
随着北非沦陷，轴心国准备应对盟军的下一步行动。
- 西欧地面部队需求增加至530
- 意大利地面部队需求增加至230，空军需求增至70
- 巴尔干地区地面部队需求增加至160，空军需求增至11

text: The Atlantic Wall
translation: 大西洋壁垒

text: With an Allied invasion of France imminent, Germany reinforces the Atlantic Wall in the West.<cr><cr>- Western Europe TB Ground Requirement increases to 570
translation: 随着盟军即将入侵法国，德国加强了西欧的“大西洋壁垒”。<cr><cr>- 西欧地面部队需求增加到570

text: All in for Cairo
translation: 全部为了开罗

text: With Axis forces 60 miles from Alexandria, the desire to reach Cairo intensifies.<cr><cr>- North Africa TB Ground Requirement increases to 85
translation: 随着轴心国部队距离亚历山大港仅60英里，攻占开罗的欲望愈发强烈。<cr>北非战区地面需求增加至85%

text: Allies Raid Norway
translation: 盟军突袭挪威

text: British carry out commando raids in Norway, including attack on atomic heavy water factilities. Norwegian resistance increases.<cr><cr>- Norway TB Ground Requirement increases to 95, Naval decreases to 17
translation: 英军在挪威展开突击队袭击，包括对重水设施的攻击。挪威抵抗运动增强。<cr>挪威地面需求增加至95，海军需求减少至17

text: Norway on the Frontline
translation: 挪威前线告急

text: With Finland out of the war, Northern Norway becomes part of the frontline.<cr><cr>- Norway TB Air Requirement increases to 15
translation: 芬兰退出战争后，北部挪威成为前线的一部分。<cr><cr>-挪威远程轰炸机需求增加至15架

text: It's Not Over
translation: 未结束

text: Although a secondary front, periodic Soviet offensives force the Finns to strengthen their defenses and remain vigilant.<cr><cr>- Finland TB Ground Requirement increases to 245, Air to 14
translation: 尽管是次要战线，苏联的周期性攻势仍迫使芬兰加强防御并保持警惕。<cr><cr>- 芬兰地面部队需求增加到245，空军需求增加到14

text: It's Only a Matter of Time
translation: 只是时间问题

text: Finland calls for a strengthening of it's defenses.<cr><cr>- Finland TB Ground Requirement increases to 260
translation: 芬兰呼吁加强其防御。<cr><cr>- 芬兰地面部队需求增加到260

text: Consolidating control
translation: 巩固控制权

text: Security units fan out into occupied territories.<cr><cr>- Soviet Union Garrison TB Ground Requirement increases to 60
translation: 治安单位分散到被占领地区。<cr>-苏联守备部队地面需求增加至60%

text: US Enters The War
translation: 美国参战

translation: 在珍珠港事件后对美国宣战，德国现在面临许多地区敌方行动增加的可能性。<cr>西欧：TB 空中需求增至73，夜间空中需求增至39<cr>意大利：TB 地面需求增至68，空中需求增至35<cr>北非：TB 地面需求增至70，空中需求增至28，海上需求增至7<cr>挪威：TB 地面需求增至82，空中需求增至8，海上需求增至24<cr>芬兰：TB 地面需求增至225

text: Security Forces Reorganize
translation: 治安部队重组

translation: 面对日益增长的游击队活动，德国治安师被扩编。<cr>-苏联守备部队地面需求增加至140

text: The Soft Underbelly
translation: 软腹部

text: The Balkans require an ever increasing garrison.<cr><cr>- Balkans TB Ground Requirement increases to 135, Air to 6
translation: 巴尔干地区需要不断增加的守备部队。<cr>- 巴尔干地面需求增加到135，空中需求增加到6

text: The Shrinking Axis
translation: 轴心国日渐式微

text: With the surrender of Italy, and the loss of the Italian air force and Navy, Germany has scant resources to contest the loss of the Mediterranean.<cr><cr>- Italy TB Air Requirement decreases to 20, Naval to 7
translation: 随着意大利的投降和其空军及海军的损失，德国在地中海几乎没有资源可以争夺。<cr>意大利空军需求减少至20，海军需求减少至7

text: Tunisia Must Be Held
translation: 突尼斯必须守住

text: The Allied invasion of Northwest Africa causes an Axis desire to hold Tunisia.<cr><cr>- North Africa TB Ground Requirement increases to 125<cr>- Italy TB Naval Requirement increases to 19
translation: 盟军入侵西北非导致轴心国希望守住突尼斯。<cr><cr>- 北非地面需求增加到125<cr>- 意大利海军需求增加到19

text: Austria on the Frontline
translation: 奥地利前线出击

text: With the end of the Italian Campaign, German forces must now defend the Austrian border.<cr><cr>- Western Europe TB Ground Requirement increases to 425
translation: 随着意大利战役的结束，德军现在必须防御奥地利边境。<cr>西方战区地面部队需求增加至425

text: NORTH AFRICA CAMPAIGN
translation: 北非战役

text: Retreat From Cyrenaica
translation: 从昔兰尼加撤退

text: Axis forces retreat from Cyrenaica.<cr><cr>- Cyrenaica region captured by the Allies
translation: 轴心国部队从昔兰尼加撤退。<cr><cr>- 昔兰尼加地区被盟军占领

text: Allies Take Northwest Africa
translation: 盟军占领西北非

text: The Allied invasion of North Africa (Operation Torch) leads to the capture of Morocco and Algeria from Vichy France.<cr><cr>- Atlantic Coast and Atlas regions are captured by the Allies<cr>- Sahara, Western and Eastern Algeria regions are captured by the Allies<cr>- Game Event Tunisia Must be Held set to Active

text: Tripoli Falls
translation: 的黎波里陷落

text: British forces occupy Tripoli.<cr><cr>- Tripolitania region captured by the Allies
translation: 英军占领的黎波里。<cr> <cr> - トリンコル尼亚地区被盟军俘获

text: Taking the Mareth Line
translation: 占领马雷斯防线

text: British Forces bypass and then capture the Mareth Line, forcing the Axis to evacuate Southern Tunisia.<cr><cr>- South Tunisia captured by the Allies
translation:
英军绕过并攻破了马雷斯防线，迫使轴心国从南 Tunisia 撤退。
- 南 Tunisia 被盟军占领

text: Sorge Spy Ring

text: Iran is Secure

text: Wolf's Lair
translation: 狼穴

text: It's June 23, 1941, and Adolf Hitler first arrives at his Eastern Front headquarters for Operation Barbarrosa. Wolf's Lair is located in the Masurian woods near the small East Prussian town of Rastenburg. Hitler will spend more than 800 days at the Wolfsschanze.<cr>Wolfsschanze is derived from 'Wolf', a self adopted nickname of Hitler. He began using the name in the early 1930s and it was often how he was addressed by those in his intimate circle.<cr>Although the standard translation of Wolfsschanze in English is 'Wolf's Lair', a schanze in German denotes a redoubt or temporary fieldwork.
translation: 这是1941年6月23日，阿道夫·希特勒首次抵达他在东方战线的巴巴罗萨行动司令部。狼穴位于东普鲁士小镇腊斯登堡附近的马祖里森林中。希特勒将在狼穴度过超过800天的时间。<cr><cr>“狼穴”来源于德语中的“狼”，这是希特勒自选的昵称。他在20世纪30年代初开始使用这个称呼，而且经常被他亲近的人这样称呼。<cr><cr>虽然“Wolfsschanze”的标准英文翻译是“狼穴”，但在德语中，“schanze”表示一个红oub或临时工事。

text: Executive Order 8802
translation: 行政命令8802号

text: Under threat of a forced march on Washington DC, on June 25 1941, President Roosevelt signs Executive Order 8802. It prohibited discrimination against blacks and women in the hiring practices of US defense jobs. Although not a law, it was the first Federal gesture towards civil rights since the Reconstruction after the American Civil War in the 1860's.
translation: 在1941年6月25日，面对华盛顿特区可能遭到强行进军的威胁，罗斯福总统签署了行政命令8802。该命令禁止在美国国防工作中招聘时对黑人和女性进行歧视。尽管这不是法律，但它自美国内战后的重建时期以来，是联邦政府在民权问题上的首次表态。

text: Mutual Assistance
translation: 相互援助

text: On July 12 1941, the United Kingdom and the Soviet Union concluded the Anglo-Soviet Agreement. This was a formal military alliance between the two powers pledging to assist each other and not make separate peace with Germany. The treaty was drawn up, signed in English and later translated into Russian, whereupon agreement between the two countries was established and authenticity recognized.
translation: 1941年7月12日，英国和苏联签署了英苏协定。这是一个正式的军事同盟，两国承诺互相协助，并不与德国单独媾和。条约用英文起草并签署，之后翻译成俄文，在双方确认后生效。

text: The V Sign
translation: V 字信号

text: On July 19,1941, Prime Minister Winston Churchill referred approvingly to the V for Victory campaign in a speech. From this point he started using the V hand sign. The V-Sign was unofficially adopted as the Allied signal, along with the motif of Beethoven's Fifth Symphony. The Germans also adopted the V-Sign, sometimes adding laurel leaves under it, painting their own V's on walls, vehicles and adding a massive V on the Eiffel Tower.
translation: 1941年7月19日，首相温斯顿·丘吉尔在演讲中对“V字胜利”运动表示赞赏，并开始使用V手势。这一手势被非正式地采纳为盟军的标志之一，另一个标志是贝多芬第五交响曲的主题。德国人也采用了V手势，有时会在下面加上月桂树叶，在墙上、车辆上绘制自己的V符号，并在埃菲尔铁塔上添加了一个巨大的V字母。<cr><cr>

text: Anglo-Soviet Invasion of Iran
translation: 英苏入侵伊朗

text: On August 25, 1941, British and Soviet troops invade Iran to save the Abadan oilfields and the inportant railways and routes to the Soviet Union for the supply of war material. In mid-September, Reza Pehlavi, the Shah of Iran, is forced to resign in favor of his son Mohammad Reza Pehlavi under pressure from the United Kingdom and the Soviet Union.<cr>The Persian Corridor (supply route through Iran into Soviet Azerbaijan) was one of three major supply routes for Lend Lease supplies to the Soviet Union. It was the only all-weather route to be developed to supply Soviet needs.<cr>The other two supply routes were the Northern Route across the North Atlantic and the Pacific Route which handled US cargo at Vladivostok, and then used the Trans-Siberian railway across the USSR.
translation: 1941年8月25日，英军和苏联军队入侵伊朗，以保护阿巴丹油田以及通往苏联的重要铁路线和补给路线。九月中旬，在英国和苏联的压力下，伊朗国王礼萨·皮勒维被迫让位于其子穆罕默德·礼萨·皮勒维。<cr>波斯走廊（通过伊朗进入苏联亚美尼亚的补给路线）是租借法案向苏联提供物资的三条主要补给线之一。它是唯一一条全年无阻的补给线路，以满足苏联的需求。<cr>另外两条补给线分别是穿越北大西洋的北方航线和处理美国货物在海参崴卸货后使用西伯利亚铁路横贯苏联的太平洋航线。

text: The USS Greer
translation: 格里尔号潜艇

text: On September 4, 1941, the USS Greer becomes the first United States warship fired upon by a German U-boat in the war, even though the US is a neutral power. Tension hightens between the two nations as a result. The US is now committed to convoy duties between the Western Hemisphere and Europe. On September 11th, Franklin D Roosevelt orders the United States Navy to shoot on sight if any ship or convoy is threatened.
translation: 1941年9月4日，美国军舰“格里尔”号成为第一次被德国U艇在战争中攻击的美国船只，尽管当时美国是中立国。两国之间的紧张关系因此加剧。美国现在承诺执行西半球与欧洲之间护航任务。9月11日，富兰克林·D·罗斯福命令美国海军一旦有船只或护航队受到威胁就立即开火。

text: First Liberty Ship
translation: 首艘自由轮

text: On September 27, 1941, the first Liberty Ship, the SS Patrick Henry is launched. Liberty Ships will prove to be major parts of the Allied supply system.
translation: 1941年9月27日，第一艘自由轮“SS帕特里克·亨利”号下水。自由轮将成为盟军补给系统的重要组成部分。

text: First Moscow Conference
translation: 第一次莫斯科会议

text: The First Moscow Conference took place from September 29 to October 1 1941. William Averell Harriman representing the US and Lord Beaverbrook representing the UK met with Joseph Stalin in Moscow. The discussions involved the promise of aid and support by the Allies to the Soviet Union in the common fight against Nazi Germany.<cr>Based on conference agreements, for the period of October 1941 through June 1942, the USA and Great Britain would provide monthly deliveries to the USSR of 400 airplanes, 500 tanks, antiaircraft and antitank guns, motor vehicles, aluminum and other metals. In return the USSR promised deliveries to the Americans and British of large quantities of raw materials needed for war production.<cr>Note: Picture is of William A. Harriman in 1941
translation: 第一次莫斯科会议于1941年9月29日至10月1日举行。美国代表威廉·阿弗尔·哈里曼和英国代表贝弗利克勋爵与约瑟夫·斯大林在莫斯科会面。会谈涉及盟国向苏联提供援助和支持的承诺，以共同对抗纳粹德国。<cr>根据会议协议，从1941年10月至1942年6月期间，美国和英国将每月向苏联运送400架飞机、500辆坦克、高射炮和反坦克炮、汽车、铝和其他金属。作为回报，苏联承诺向美英提供大量用于战争生产的原材料。<cr>注：图片为威廉·阿弗尔·哈里曼1941年的照片

text: The Kearny Incident
translation: 卡尔尼事件

text: On October 17, 1941, the American destroyer USS Kearny is torpedoed and damaged by U-568 near Iceland, killing eleven sailors. They are the first American casualties of the War.<cr>In October, while the US was still neutral in WWII, the Kearny was docked at Reykjavik, in US-occupied Iceland. A U-boat wolfpack attacked a nearby convoy and overwhelmed its Canadian escorts. Kearny and three other US destroyers were summoned to assist. Immediately upon reaching the action, Kearny dropped depth charges on the U-boats, and continued to barrage throughout the night. (This action was specifically cited as a provocation in Hitler's declaration of war on the US, two months later). At the beginning of the midwatch on October 17th, a torpedo fired by U-568 struck the Kearny on the starboard side. The forward fire room and engine room were flooded, but power from the aft engine and fire room enabled the destroyer to escape the battle zone and return to Iceland for temporary repairs. Eleven men were killed and 22 wounded.<cr>The survival of the Kearny led to renewed support to split fire rooms and engine rooms in naval vessels.<cr>Note Picture: The USS Kearny (DD-432) alongside the USS Monssen (DD-436) in the harbor of Reykjavik. Visible is the hole from the torpedo fired from U-568.
translation: 1941年10月17日，美国驱逐舰“基尔尼”号在冰岛附近被U-568潜艇鱼雷击中受损，十一名水手丧生。他们是战争中的首批美军阵亡者。<cr>指挥官报告: 1941年10月，在二战期间美国仍保持中立时，“基尔尼”号停泊在冰岛的雷克雅未克港内（当时冰岛由美军占领）。一支U艇狼群袭击了附近的一支商船队，并压倒了其加拿大护航舰。随后“基尔尼”号和另外三艘美国驱逐舰被召唤前往支援。一到达战场，“基尔尼”号就投放深水炸弹攻击潜艇，并在整夜持续轰炸。（此行动后来成为希特勒两个月后向美国宣战时的导火索之一）。10月17日凌晨班次开始不久，U-568发射的一枚鱼雷击中了“基尔尼”号的右舷。前部锅炉舱和机舱被淹没，但来自后部发动机和锅炉舱的动力使驱逐舰得以逃离战场并返回冰岛进行临时维修。十一人丧生，二十二人受伤。<cr>“基尔尼”的幸存促使人们重新支持在海军舰艇中将锅炉舱和机舱分开的设计。<cr>注意图片：“基尔尼”号（DD-432）与“蒙森”号（DD-436）停泊在雷克雅未克港内。可以看到U-568发射的鱼雷留下的孔洞。

text: Soviet Govt Evacuates Moscow
translation: 苏联政府撤离莫斯科

text: With German forces approaching the capital, Stalin orders the evacuation of the Communist Party, the General Staff and various civil government offices from Moscow to Kuybyshev, leaving only a limited number of officials behind. The evacuation causes panic among Muscovites. Much of the civilian population tries to flee, mobbing the available trains and jamming the roads from the city. Despite all this, Stalin publicly remains in the Soviet capital, somewhat calming the fear and pandemonium.
translation: 随着德国军队逼近首都，斯大林命令共产党和总参谋部从莫斯科撤离至库尔斯克，并留下少量官员。撤离行动在市民中引发了恐慌。大量平民试图逃离，挤满了可用的火车和通往城外的道路。尽管如此，斯大林仍公开留在苏联首都，这在一定程度上缓解了人们的恐惧和混乱。

text: Lend Lease Dollars
translation: 贷款援助美元

text: October 30, 1941, US President Roosevelt approves one billion US dollars in Lend-Lease aid to the Soviet Union.<cr>Note Picture: A M3 'Stuart' light tank and a dismantled Douglas A-20 'Boston' aircraft on board a cargo ship.
translation: 1941年10月30日，美国总统罗斯福批准向苏联提供十亿美元的租借法案援助。<cr>注：图片说明：一艘货轮上装载着M3“斯图亚特”轻型坦克和拆解后的道格拉斯A-20“波士顿”轰炸机。

text: Stalin Speaks Out
translation: 斯大林发表讲话

text: November 6, 1941, Soviet leader Joseph Stalin addresses the Soviet Union for only the second time during his three-decade rule (the first time was on July 3rd of 1941). He states that even though 350,000 troops were killed in German attacks so far, that the Germans have lost 4.5 million soldiers (a gross exaggeration) and that Soviet victory is near.
translation: 1941年11月6日，苏联领导人约瑟夫·斯大林在其三十年统治期间仅第二次对苏联发表讲话（第一次是在1941年7月3日）。他宣称尽管已有35万苏军在德军进攻中阵亡，但德军已损失了450万名士兵（严重夸大），并表示苏联的胜利即将到来。

text: 1941/42 Very Cold Winter

November 12, 1941. Temperatures in the Moscow area drop to -12 degrees Celsius. The beginning of one of the coldest Russian winters in the twentieth century. During 1941/42 winter, temperatures across central Russia will drop below -20 degrees Celsius in late December through early January. Khodynka airfield meteostation in Moscow recorded spikes down to -33 degrees Celsius, in late December. Kalinin, north of Moscow recorded -50 degrees Celsius.
translation: 1941年11月12日。莫斯科地区的气温降至零下12摄氏度。二十世纪俄罗斯最寒冷的冬天之一开始了。在1941/42年的冬季，从12月底到次年初，俄罗斯中部地区的气温将下降至零下20摄氏度以下。莫斯科霍季诺卡机场气象站记录显示，在12月底温度曾骤降至零下33摄氏度。位于莫斯科以北的加里宁则记录到了零下50摄氏度的低温。

text: Britain Includes Everybody
translation: 英国全民参战

text: As of December 18, 1941, conscription in the United Kingdom now includes all men between the ages of 18 and 50. Women will not be neglected since they will serve in the fire brigades and the women's auxiliary groups.
translation: 截至1941年12月18日，英国的征兵范围扩大到所有年龄在18至50岁之间的男性。女性也不会被忽视，她们将在消防队和妇女辅助团体中服役。

text: Busy Day for Japan
translation: 日本忙碌的一天

text: December 7, 1941 (December 8, Asian time zones), is a busy day for Japan:<cr>Imperial Navy launches an attack on Pearl Harbor<cr>Declares war on the United States and the United Kingdom<cr>Invades Thailand and British Malaya<cr>Launches aerial attacks against Guam, Hong Kong, the Philipines, Shanghai, Singapore and Wake Island<cr>Note: Picture of USS California (BB-44) slowly sinking
translation: 1941年12月7日（亚洲时区为12月8日），日本忙于发动一系列攻击：@帝国海军对珍珠港发起攻击@宣布对美国和英国宣战@入侵泰国和英属马来亚@对关岛、香港、菲律宾、上海、新加坡和威克岛发动空袭@注：USS加州号（BB-44）缓缓沉没的画面

text: Strange Alliance
translation: 奇怪的联盟

text: Also known as The Big Three, The Grand Alliance, was a military alliance consisting of the three major Allied powers of World War II, the United States, the Soviet Union, and the United Kingdom.<cr>It has often been called the 'Strange Alliance' because it united the world's greatest 'capitalist state', the greatest 'communist state' and the greatest 'colonial power'.<cr>It was an alliance of convenience in the fight against the Axis powers. The British had reason to ask for one as Germany, Italy and Imperial Japan threatened not only Britain's colonies in North Africa and Asia, but also the home islands. The United States believed German and Japanese expansion should be contained, but ruled out force until Japan's attack upon Pearl Harbor. The Soviet Union, after the breaking of the Nazi-Soviet Pact with the instigation of Operation Barbarossa, greatly despised the unchallenged Japanese expansion in the East. They also recognized, as the US and Britain had suggested, the advantages of a two-front war.
translation: 也被称为“三大国”或“大同盟”，这是一个由二战中的三个主要盟国——美国、苏联和英国组成的军事联盟。<cr>它常被称作“奇怪的联盟”，因为它联合了世界上最大的“资本主义国家”、最大的“共产主义国家”以及最大的“殖民帝国”。<cr>这是对抗轴心国的一种权宜之计的联盟。英国因德国、意大利和日本帝国对北非和亚洲英属殖民地乃至本土岛屿的威胁而有理由寻求这种联盟。美国认为应遏制德日扩张，但在珍珠港事件之前一直排除使用武力的可能性。苏联在纳粹-苏维埃互不侵犯条约破裂后，在巴巴罗萨行动的发动下，非常憎恶日本在东方未受挑战的扩张。他们也认识到，正如美英所建议的那样，两线作战具有优势。

text: Hitler Takes Command
translation: 希特勒接管指挥权

text: On December 19 1941, in a major shake-up of the military high command, Adolf Hitler assumed the position of commander in chief of the German Army. He declared he would train it 'in a National Socialist Way' - that is by personal decree. 'He would compose the strategies and the officers would dance to his tune.'
translation: 1941年12月19日，军事高层进行了一次重大调整，阿道夫·希特勒接任德军总司令。他宣布将“以国家社会主义的方式”训练军队——也就是说通过个人指令。“他会制定战略，军官们则会遵命行事。”

text: Declaration by United Nations
translation: 联合国家宣示宣言

text: January 1, 1942, twenty-six Allied countries sign the Declaration by United Nations at the Arcadia Conference in Washington DC. This document is the first concrete plan for a new world organization. The Declaration by United Nations was the basis for the modern day United Nations (UN) founded in 1945. The term United Nations became synonymous during the war with the Allies and was considered to be the formal name they were fighting under.
translation: 1942年1月1日，二十六个盟国在华盛顿特区的阿卡迪亚会议上签署了《联合国家宣言》。这是第一个具体计划的新世界组织方案。《联合国家宣言》是1945年成立的现代联合国（UN）的基础。在战争期间，“联合国家”一词与盟军同义，被认为是他们作战时使用的正式名称。

text: Second Happy Time
translation: 第二次快乐时光

text: Silhouetted against the lights of Manhattan, eight unarmed vessels are sunk by a German U-boat. By the end of January 1942, U-boats would sink 25 tankers along the US East Coast. This was the beginning of the 'Second Happy Time'.<cr>The Second Happy Time (sometimes called the American Shooting Season) was the informal name among German submarine commanders for a phase in the Battle of the Atlantic during which Axis submarines attacked merchant shipping and Allied naval vessels along the east coast of North America. It lasted from January to August of 1942, and involved several German naval operations, including Operation Paukenschlag (Drumbeat) and Operation Neuland. German submariners referred to it as the happy time or golden time, because Allied naval defense measures were weak and disorganized, and the U-boats were able to inflict massive damage with little risk.<cr>During this period, Axis submarines sank 609 ships totaling 3.1 million tons and the loss of thousands of lives, mainly those of merchant mariners, against a loss of only 22 U-boats. It was roughly one quarter of all shipping sunk by U-boats during the entire Second World War.<cr>The First Happy Time was the U-boat campaign during 1940-1941.<cr>Note Picture: Tanker SS Pennsylvania Sun burning, torpedoed by U-571, July 1942.
translation: 在曼哈顿灯光的映衬下，8艘无武装船只被德国潜艇击沉。到1942年1月结束时，潜艇将在美国东海岸击沉25艘油轮。这是“第二次快乐时光”的开始。<cr>第二次快乐时光（有时也被称为美国狩猎季节）是德军潜艇指挥官对大西洋之战中一个阶段的非正式称呼，在此期间轴心国潜艇袭击了北美东海岸的商船和盟军海军舰艇。这一时期从1942年1月持续到8月，涉及多个德国海军行动，包括“鼓声”行动（Paukenschlag）和新土地行动（Neuland）。德军潜艇兵将其称为快乐时光或黄金时光，因为盟军的海防措施薄弱且混乱，而潜艇能够以极小的风险造成巨大损失。<cr>在此期间，轴心国潜艇击沉了609艘船只，总吨位达310万吨，并导致数千人丧生，主要是商船水手。相比之下，只有22艘潜艇被击毁。这大约占二战期间潜艇击沉所有船只总量的四分之一。<cr>第一次快乐时光是指1940年至1941年的U艇战役。<cr>注意图片：油轮SS Pennsylvania Sun在1942年7月被U-571鱼雷击中后燃烧。

text: The Yanks Arrive
translation: 美军参战

text: On January 26, 1942, the first American forces arrive in Europe, landing in Northern Ireland. The 133rd Infantry Regiment of the 34th Infantry Division was the first United States Army unit sent to Europe in World War II. The first battalion arrived in Belfast, followed by the rest of the regiment in February. These units were designated as US Army Northern Ireland forces (or MAGNET forces). The 133rd and 168th Infantry Regiments trained in the peat bogs and performed border guard patrols between British North Ireland and the neutral Irish Free State.<cr>The American Eigth Air Force was activated and the VIII Bomber Command (VIII BC) was sent to England. On February 22nd, the VIII BC was established at RAF Daws Hill, in High Wycombe.
translation: 1942年1月26日，第一批美国部队抵达欧洲，在北爱尔兰登陆。第34步兵师的第133步兵团是二战期间第一个被派往欧洲的美军单位。第一营于2月初抵达贝尔法斯特，随后该团其余部分在二月份陆续到达。这些单位被指定为驻北爱尔兰美军（或磁铁部队）。第133和第168步兵团在泥炭沼泽中训练，并执行边境巡逻任务，在英国北爱尔兰与中立的爱尔兰自由邦之间巡逻。<cr>美国第八空军成立，第八轰炸机司令部（VIII BC）被派往英格兰。2月22日，VIII BC在英格兰的达斯山皇家空军基地正式建立。

text: SS Normandie
translation: 诺曼底党卫军

text: The SS Normandie was a French ocean liner built in the early 1930's. She entered service in 1935 as the largest and fastest passenger ship afloat. She is still considered the most powerful steam turbo-electric-propelled passenger ship ever built.<cr>The war found Normandie in New York harbor. On September 3 1939, the US government interned her, just 2 days after Germany invaded Poland. The ship remained in New York harbor, but retained her French crew and captain. During the Battle of France in 1940, US Coast Guardsmen were detailed to board the ship to defend her against possible sabotage. In December of 1941, 5 days after the attack on Pearl Harbor, the US Coast Guard took possession of the Normandie. Later in that same month the ship was transferred to the US Navy and was renamed the USS Lafayette. Plans were to convert the vessel to a troopship.<cr>On February 10th, during the conversion process, the ship caught fire and capsized on her port side, coming to rest on the mud of the Hudson River at pier 88. Although salvaged at great expense, restoration was deemed too costly. The ship was scrapped after the war.
translation: 诺曼底号是一艘法国远洋客轮，建于20世纪30年代初期。该船在1935年投入使用时，是当时最大和最快的客运船只。它仍然是有史以来建造的最强大的蒸汽涡轮电力推进客轮。<cr><cr>战争爆发时，诺曼底号停泊在美国纽约港。1939年9月3日，美国政府将该船扣留，仅仅在德国入侵波兰两天之后。这艘船仍然停泊在纽约港，但保留了法国船员和船长。在1940年的法国战役期间，美国海岸警卫队人员被派往登船以防御可能的破坏行为。1941年12月，在珍珠港事件发生5天后，美国海岸警卫队接管了诺曼底号。同月晚些时候，该船转交给美国海军，并更名为拉法耶特号。计划将这艘船改装为运输舰。<cr><cr>在1942年2月10日的改装过程中，船只发生火灾并侧翻到左舷，在哈德逊河88号码头附近的泥泞中搁浅。尽管花费巨资打捞，但修复成本被认为过高。战后该船被拆解。

text: The Channel Dash
translation: 英吉利海峡突破行动

text: Based on Adolf Hitler's perceived threat of a possible British invasion of Norway, on February 11, 1942, the German navy carried out Operation Cerberus (Unternehmen Zerberus). A naval squadron of the battleships Scharnhorst and Gneisenau, with the heavy cruiser Prinz Eugen and escorts, ran a British blockade from Brest up the English Channel to northern German ports. The Luftwaffe provided air cover as the ships neared Dover. The British RAF, navy and coastal artillery belatedly began operations against the German ships, but failed to intercept them. Although the battleships were damaged by mines in the North Sea, the squadron reached German ports two days later. The British daily paper The Times denounced the British fiasco and Winston Churchill ordered an inquiry into the debacle. The German navy considered the operation a tactical success, but a strategic failure, by exchanging a threat to the Allied Atlantic convoys by German warships for a hypothetical threat to Norway.
translation: 基于阿道夫·希特勒对英国可能入侵挪威的威胁感知，1942年2月11日，德国海军实施了“刻耳柏洛斯行动”（ Unternehmen Cerberus）。由战列舰沙恩霍斯特号和格奈森瑙号、重型巡洋舰尤金亲王号及其护航舰队组成的海军编队从布雷斯特出发，在英吉利海峡突破英国封锁线，抵达德国北部港口。当船只接近多佛尔时，德国空军提供了空中掩护。英国皇家空军、海军及海岸炮兵迟滞地开始对德军船只进行拦截行动，但未能成功截击它们。尽管战列舰在北海遭遇水雷袭击而受损，编队还是在两天后抵达了德国港口。英国每日电讯报谴责了这一英方的失败，并要求温斯顿·丘吉尔对此事件展开调查。德国海军认为此次行动从战术上来说是成功的，但从战略上看则是失败的，因为用对盟军大西洋护航舰队的威胁换取了一个假设性的对挪威的威胁。

text: UK Rationing Becomes Worse
translation: 英国配给情况恶化

text: In March of 1942, the United Kingdom institutes rationing of electricity, coal and gas. Central Heating is prohibited 'in the summer months'. The clothing ration is decreased as well. From March to May severe measures were introduced which restricted the number of buttons, pockets and pleats on clothes.<cr>By 1942, in the United Kingdom, children between the ages of 5 and 7 had become used to wartime restrictions. When questioned about bananas, many did not believe such items existed.
translation: 1942年3月，英国开始实行电力、煤炭和煤气的配给制度。禁止在“夏季月份”使用中央供暖系统。服装配给量也有所减少。从3月至5月，采取了严厉措施限制衣物上的纽扣数量、口袋数量以及褶皱。<cr>到1942年，在英国，年龄在5至7岁之间的儿童已经习惯了战时的种种限制。当被问及香蕉时，许多人不相信这些物品存在。

text: War Balloons
translation: 战球气球

text: On March 20, 1942, Operation Outward begins. This was the name given to the British World War II program to attack Germany by means of free-flying balloons. It made use of cheap, simple balloons filled with hydrogen. They carried either a trailing steel wire intended to damage high voltage power lines by producing a short circuit, or incendiary devices that were intended to start fires in fields, forests and heathland. A total of 99,142 'Outward' balloons were launched.<cr>Compared to Japan's better known Fire Balloons, Outward balloons were crude. They had to travel a much shorter distance so they flew at a lower altitude (16,000 feet), compared to Japan's Fire Balloons (38,000 feet). They had only a simple mechanism to regulate altitude by means of dropping ballast or venting lifting gas. This meant the balloons were simple to mass-produce and cost only 35 shillings each.<cr>The free-flying balloon attacks were highly successful. Although difficult to assess exactly, they had an economic impact on Germany far in excess of the cost to the British goverment.
translation: 1942年3月20日，代号“外向行动”的英国二战计划开始实施。该计划旨在通过自由飞行的气球攻击德国。这些气球使用廉价且简单的氢气填充物制成。它们携带了两种装置：一种是拖曳钢丝，目的是在高压输电线中制造短路以造成损害；另一种是燃烧装置，意图是在田野、森林和荒地上引发火灾。总计有99,142个“外向行动”气球被放飞。<cr>与日本更为人知的‘火球’相比，“外向行动”的气球较为粗糙。它们需要飞行较短的距离，因此在较低的高度（16,000英尺）飞行，而日本的‘火球’则是在更高的高度（38,000英尺）。这些气球仅通过抛洒重物或释放升力气体来调节高度。这意味着气球非常易于大规模生产，并且每个成本仅为35先令。<cr>自由飞行气球攻击取得了巨大成功。尽管难以准确评估，但它们对德国的经济影响远远超过了英国政府的成本。

text: Tit for Tat
translation: 以其人之道还治其人之身

text: On March 28, 1942, the RAF sends a raid against the city of Luebeck in Northern Germany. The attack creates a firestorm that destroys over 80% of the city's historic medieval centre. Three of the centre's main churches and large parts of the built-up area are destroyed.<cr>Adolf Hitler is enraged by this and orders the Luftwaffe to respond with equivalent retaliation.<cr>In late April thru the end of May, the Luftwaffe conducts the Baedeker Blitz, a series of raids on popular tourist and historic British sites. The aim is to begin a 'tit-for-tat' exchange with the hope of forcing the RAF to reduce their actions. The name of these raids comes from a comment made at the time by a spokesman for the German Foreign Office:<cr>'We shall go out and bomb every building in Britain marked with three stars in the Baedeker Guide'<cr>The attempt is an abject failure. Due to the RAF's improved night fighter and radar capabilities, the Luftwaffe suffers unsustainable losses for minimal damage to the targeted cities. Nevertheless the raids result in over 1,600 civilian deaths and damage to tens of thousands of homes.<cr>Note Picture: Luebeck Cathedral burning after British air raid.
translation: 1942年3月28日，英国皇家空军对德国北部的吕贝克市发动了一次空袭。这次攻击引发了大火，导致该城市具有历史意义的中世纪市中心超过80%的部分被摧毁。市中心的主要教堂有三座遭到破坏，大片建筑区域也被毁坏。<cr>阿道夫·希特勒对此极为愤怒，并命令德国空军采取同等报复措施。<cr>4月下旬至5月底，德国空军展开了贝德克尔空袭行动，对英国的热门旅游和历史名胜进行了一系列轰炸。其目的是开始一场“以牙还牙”的交换，希望迫使皇家空军减少他们的攻击行为。<cr>这些袭击的名字来源于当时德国外交部发言人的一句话：“我们将前往英国，并轰炸所有在贝德克尔指南中标记为三星级的建筑。”<cr>然而，由于英国夜间战斗机和雷达能力的提升，德国空军遭受了无法持续的损失，对目标城市的破坏却微乎其微。尽管如此，这些袭击仍导致超过1600名平民死亡，并损坏了数以万计的家庭住宅。<cr>注：吕贝克大教堂在英国空袭后燃烧的照片。

text: The 'Bucket Brigaid'
translation: '水桶敢死队'

text: The US Navy's operational command the Eastern Sea Frontier is responsible for the coastal waters along the Eastern Seaboard from Canada down to Jacksonville, Florida, extending outward into the Atlantic a distance of two hundred miles.<cr>In Spring of 1942 the command is desperately short on suitable escort vessels for convoy duty. Before additional escort destroyers can be provided, the command institutes an interim arrangement known as the 'Bucket Brigaid'. Vessels outside of harbors are placed in anchorages protected by netting after dark, and moved only under whatever escort is availble during the day.<cr>As word of this and similar measures reach German admiral Doenitz, he does not wait to test their effectiveness, but instead shifts his U-boats to a different area of the eastern Atlantic, where American anti-submarine measures are not as effective. His new area of operations includes the Bahamas, the Gulf of Mexico, the Yucatan Channel and areas around Cuba.<cr>As a result, in May more Allied shipping is sunk in the Gulf, especially off the passes of the Mississippi river, than off the entire Eastern Seaboard.<cr>Note Picture: Vice Admiral Adolphus Andrews, commander, Eastern Sea Frontier (EASTSEAFRON).
translation: 美国海军东部海域前沿指挥部负责从加拿大到佛罗里达杰克逊维尔的东海岸沿岸水域，向外延伸至大西洋两百英里的范围。<cr>1942年春天，该指挥部在护航舰艇方面极度短缺。在额外提供护航驱逐舰之前，指挥部实施了一项临时安排，称为“水桶消防队”。夜间将港外的船只锚定在用网围起来的安全区域，并在白天根据可用情况移动这些船只。<cr>当德国海军上将邓尼茨得知此类措施时，他没有等待测试其效果，而是将U艇转移到大西洋东部的不同区域，在那里美国的反潜措施不太有效。新的作战区域包括巴哈马群岛、墨西哥湾、尤卡坦海峡和古巴周边地区。<cr>结果是，5月在墨西哥湾被盟军船只击沉的数量尤其多，特别是在密西西比河口附近，超过了整个东海岸的总和。<cr>注：图片：东部海域前沿指挥官阿道夫斯·安德鲁斯中将（EASTSEAFRON）。

text: USS Roper and U-85
translation: 罗珀号和U-85

text: The Roper was an old 4-stack Wickes-class destroyer in the US Navy, later converted to a high speed transport and redesignated APD-20. The U-85 was a Type VIIB U-boat of Nazi Germany's Kriegsmarine and was assigned to the 7th U-boat flotilla.<cr>During the night of April 13/14 1942, the two vessels encountered each other in a deadly confrontation off the coast of US North Carolina.<cr>The U-85, while operating within visual distance of Bodie Island Light, was detected by the Roper. The boat attempted to run south on the surface and fired her stern torpedo at Roper when the range closed to 700 yards. Roper evaded the torpedo and U-85 turned sharply to starboard when the range closed to 300 yards. Roper illuminated the U-boat with her searchlight and observed men on deck near the gun whose firing arc had just been cleared by the course change. Roper raked U-85 with machine gun fire and scored a hit with a 3inch/50 caliber gun. She then dropped a pattern of 11 depth charges where U-85 had disappeared beneath the surface. The Roper attempted a rescue at daylight, but there were no survivors.<cr>The USS Roper was the first American ship to sink a U-boat.<cr>Note: Picture of USS Roper (DD-147) and USS Talbot (DD-114)
translation: 罗珀号是一艘美国海军的老式四烟囱威克斯级驱逐舰，后来改装为高速运输船并重新编号为APD-20。U-85是纳粹德国海军的VIIB型潜艇，并被分配到第7潜艇中队。<cr>1942年4月13/14日夜，这两艘舰艇在美国北卡罗来纳州海岸外相遇并发生致命冲突。<cr>U-85在博迪岛灯塔附近海域作业时被罗珀号发现。潜艇试图向南表面航行，并在距离缩小到700码时发射尾部鱼雷攻击罗珀号。罗珀号成功避开鱼雷，当距离缩短至300码时，U-85突然转向右舷。罗珀号用探照灯照射潜艇并注意到甲板上靠近刚被航向改变清空的炮手位置有人员活动。罗珀号用机枪火力扫射U-85，并用3英寸/50倍径火炮击中目标。随后，它投放了11枚深水炸弹到U-85消失在水面下的区域。<cr>罗珀号试图在黎明时进行救援行动，但没有发现幸存者。<cr>美国海军罗珀号是第一艘击沉德国潜艇的美军舰艇。<cr>注：USS Roper (DD-147) 和 USS Talbot (DD-114) 的图片

text: All of North America
translation: 整个北美洲

text: On May 14 1942 the Mexican tanker Potrero del Llano is sunk by U-564. The tanker was sailing unescorted from Tampico to New York City with 6,132 tons of petroleum. She was sighted by U-564 while east of the coast of US Florida. The German commander noticed an illuminated flag painted on the side of the ship, but misidentified it as the Italian flag. Since only ships of the Mexican Navy were permitted to display the Mexican flag with the eagle in the center, the flag shown by the Potrero del Llano resembled the Italian one. Having decided the tanker's position and course meant that she could not be Italian, U-564 sank her, with the loss of 13 of her crew.<cr>Up to this point Mexico had remained neutral. On May 21st, the Mexican Foreign Office reported that Germany refused to accept Mexico's protest against the sinking of the tanker. The following day, the Mexican government announced its first ever declaration of war.<cr>All of North America is now involved in the fight against the Axis Powers.<cr>Note Picture: The Potrero del Llano burns close to the Florida coast, after being torpedoed.
translation: 1942年5月14日，墨西哥油轮Potrero del Llano被U-564潜艇击沉。该油轮正从坦皮科前往纽约市，载有6,132吨石油，并且没有护航。当它在美国佛罗里达州东海岸附近航行时，被U-564发现。德国指挥官注意到船侧有一面点亮的旗帜，但误认为是意大利国旗。由于只有墨西哥海军船只才允许展示中间带有鹰徽的墨西哥国旗，Potrero del Llano上展示的旗帜与意大利国旗相似。确定该油轮的位置和航线不可能属于意大利后，U-564将其击沉，导致13名船员丧生。<cr>截至此时，墨西哥一直保持中立。5月21日，墨西哥外交部报告称德国拒绝接受墨西哥对油轮被击沉的抗议。次日，墨西哥政府宣布了其历史上首次宣战。<cr>现在整个北美洲都加入了对抗轴心国的战斗。<cr>注意图片：Potrero del Llano在佛罗里达海岸附近燃烧，刚刚遭到鱼雷攻击。

text: Operation Anthropoid
translation: 人种学行动

text: Operation Anthropoid was the code name for the assassination of SS leader Reinhard Heydrich. Heydrich was one of the most powerful men in Nazi Germany and an important figure in the rise of Adolf Hitler. He was given overall charge of the Final Solution (Holocaust) in occupied Europe. In September of 1941, he was appointed acting 'Protector of Bohemia and Moravia'.<cr>Prepared by the British Special Operations Executive, the Czechoslovakians undertook the operation to help confer legitimacy on Edvard Benes's Czechoslovak government-in-exile in London, as well as for retribution against Heydrich's brutally efficient rule.<cr>The attack was carried out in Prague on May 27 1942. Wounded by the detonation of a modified anti-tank grenade (concealed in a briefcase), Heydrich died of his injuries in June of that year.<cr>This was the only targeted assassination by the Allies of a senior Nazi leader during the Second World War.<cr>Note: Picture of Heydrich's Mercedes-Benz 320 after the attack
translation: 刺杀行动“人类学家”是暗杀党卫军领导人赖因哈德·海德里希的代号。海德里希是纳粹德国最有权势的人物之一，也是阿道夫·希特勒崛起的重要人物。他被赋予了在占领欧洲执行最终解决方案（大屠杀）的总体责任。1941年9月，他被任命为捷克斯洛伐克保护国——波西米亚和摩拉维亚地区的代理保护者。<cr>准备行动“人类学家”的是英国特别作战执行局，捷克斯洛伐克人实施了这次行动，以帮助赋予伦敦的爱德华·贝奈斯流亡政府合法性，并对海德里希残酷高效的统治进行报复。<cr>攻击于1942年5月27日在布拉格实施。海德里希被一枚改装过的反坦克手榴弹（藏在公文包中）炸伤，同年6月因伤势过重而死亡。<cr>这是盟军在整个第二次世界大战期间唯一针对高级纳粹领导人的暗杀行动。<cr>注意：攻击后海德里希的梅赛德斯-奔驰320照片

text: More Declarations of War
translation: 更多宣战声明

text: On June 2 1942, in a speech to the US Congress, Franklin Roosevelt recommended that the Congress recognize a state of war between the US and Bulgaria, Hungary and Rumania. In his message to Congress Roosevelt stated that although these countries had earlier declared war on the US, he believed they had done so under duress and against the will of their peoples. But as the war has progressed, these governments have engaged in military activities directed against the United Nations and are planning an extension of these activities.<cr>On June 4 1942, the United States declared war on Bulgaria, Hungary and Rumania.
translation: 1942年6月2日，富兰克林·罗斯福在美国国会发表演讲，建议国会对美国与保加利亚、匈牙利和罗马尼亚之间的战争状态予以承认。在致国会的信中，罗斯福表示尽管这些国家之前曾宣布对美宣战，但他认为那是被迫所为，并非出于人民意愿。然而随着战争的发展，这些政府已参与了针对联合国的军事活动，并计划进一步扩大此类行动。<cr>1942年6月4日，美国正式向保加利亚、匈牙利和罗马尼亚宣战。

text: Second Moscow Conference
translation: 第二次莫斯科会议

text: The Second Moscow Conference between the major Allies of World War II took place from August 12th through the 17th of 1942. Winston Churchill and William Averell Harriman (from the US) met with Joseph Stalin at the Kremlin. They discussed grand strategy, planning for the North African campaign and the later landing and opening of a second front in France.<cr>For several months Stalin had been urgently requesting a British-American invasion of France. Churchill explained there would be no second front that year. The will was there, said Churchill, but there were not enough American troops, not enough tanks, not enough shipping, not enough air superiority. Instead the British, and soon the Americans, would step up bombing of German cities and railways. Furthermore, there would be a major Anglo-American invasion of North Africa, which would set the stage for an invasion of Italy and perhaps open the Mediterranean for munitions shipments to Russia through the Black Sea.
translation: 第二次世界大战主要盟国之间的第二次莫斯科会议于1942年8月12日至17日在克里姆林宫举行。温斯顿·丘吉尔和来自美国的威廉·阿弗尔·哈里曼与约瑟夫·斯大林会面，讨论了总体战略、北非战役的计划以及在法国开辟第二战场的后续登陆事宜。<cr><cr>几个月来，斯大林一直在急切地要求英美两国入侵法国。丘吉尔解释说，当年不会开辟第二个战场。他说，决心是有的，但没有足够的美军部队，没有足够的坦克，没有足够的运输能力，也没有制空权。相反，英国人很快就会加大轰炸德国城市和铁路的力度。此外，将会有主要的英美联军入侵北非行动，这将为入侵意大利铺平道路，并可能通过黑海向俄罗斯运送武器装备，从而打开地中海通道。

text: Commando Order
translation: 命令o号令

text: The Commando Order, issued by the German High Command on October 18, 1942, stated that all Allied commandos encountered in Europe and North Africa should be killed immediately without trial, even if in proper uniforms or they attempted to surrender. Any commandos, agents and saboteurs not in proper uniforms who fell into the hands of German forces by means other than direct combat(eg. through the police in occupied territories), were to be handed over to the SD. The order, issued in secret, made it clear that failure to carry out these orders by any officer would be considered an act of negligence punishable under German military law.<cr>This was in fact the second 'Commando Order', the first being issued by Generalfeldmarshall Gerd von Rundstedt three months earlier, stipulating that parachutists should be handed over to the Gestapo.<cr>Shortly after the war, at the Nuremberg Trials, the order was found to be a direct breach of the laws of war, and German officers who carried out illegal executions under the Commando Order were found guilty of war crimes.<cr>Note Picture: POWs-commandos of 1st Special Service Brigade, June 1942.
translation: 德国最高统帅部于1942年10月18日发布的《指挥官命令》规定，所有在欧洲和北非遇到的盟军突击队成员应立即被处决，无需审判，即使他们穿着正规制服或试图投降也不例外。任何不在正规制服中的突击队员、特工和破坏分子如果通过除直接战斗外的方式（例如通过占领区内的警察）落入德军手中，则应移交给安全警察SD。该秘密发布的命令明确指出，任何军官未能执行这些命令都将被视为疏忽行为，并根据德国军事法律受到惩罚。<cr>这实际上是第二个《指挥官命令》，第一个由陆军元帅格尔德·冯·龙斯特德特在三个月前发布，规定空降兵应移交给盖世太保。<cr>战后不久，在纽伦堡审判中，《指挥官命令》被认定为直接违反战争法的行为，并且执行非法处决的德国军官因战争罪被判有罪。<cr>Note Picture: 1st特种服务旅战俘突击队员，1942年6月。

text: First Chain Reaction
translation: 首次链式反应

text: The Atomic Age began on December 2nd of 1942 - quietly, in secrecy, on a squash court under the west stands of old Stagg Field at the University of Chicago. Professor Enrico Fermi and his colleagues engineered the first controlled, self-sustaining nuclear reaction. Their experiment, although too weak to power even a single light bulb, was a key step in the Manhattan Project to develop the atomic bomb in World War II.<cr>Picture: Enrico Fermi
translation: 原子时代始于1942年12月2日——在一个秘密的环境中，位于芝加哥大学旧斯塔格田径场西看台下的一个壁球馆内。教授恩里科·费米和他的同事们制造了第一个可控、自持的核反应。尽管他们的实验强度不足以点亮一盏灯泡，但它却是曼哈顿计划开发原子弹的关键步骤。<cr><cr>图片：Enrico Fermi

text: Unconditional Surrender
translation: 无条件投降

text: Code named SYMBOL, the Casablanca Conference was held at the Anfa Hotel in Casablanca, French Morroco from January 14th through the 24th of 1943. In attendance were President Franklin D. Roosevelt and Prime Minister Winston Churchill. Premier Joseph Stalin had declined to attend, citing ongoing major military operations requiring his presence in the Soviet Union.<cr>The conference produced a unified statement of purpose, the Casablanca Declaration, which announced to the world that the Allies would accept nothing less than the 'unconditional surrender' of the Axis powers. Roosevelt had borrowed the term from Ulysses S. Grant, the Union general who had communicated this stance to the Confederate commander of Fort Donelson and Fort Henry during the American Civil War.<cr>In a February 12th radio address, Roosevelt explained what he meant by unconditional surrender: 'we mean no harm to the common people of the Axis nations. But we do mean to impose punishment and retribution upon their guilty, barbaric leaders'.<cr>That the war would be fought by the Allies until the total annihilation of enemy forces was not universally welcomed. Diplomatic insiders were critical that such a stance was too unequivocal, and inflexible, cancelling out any opportunity for political maneuvering, and morally debilitating to French and German resistance groups
translation: 代号为SYMBOL的卡萨布兰卡会议于1943年1月14日至24日在法属摩洛哥卡萨布兰加纳酒店举行。与会者包括美国总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福和英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔。苏联领导人约瑟夫·斯大林因在苏联有重大军事行动而未能出席。<cr>会议产生了统一的声明，即卡萨布兰卡宣言，宣布盟国将接受无条件投降作为唯一解决方案。<cr>罗斯福借用的是尤利塞斯·S·格兰特将军在美国南北战争期间对南方邦联要塞唐纳森和亨利堡指挥官所传达的态度。<cr>在2月12日的广播讲话中，罗斯福解释了他所说的无条件投降：“我们无意伤害轴心国国家普通民众的利益。但我们确实打算对那些罪恶、野蛮的领导人施加惩罚。”<cr>盟军将战斗到彻底消灭敌方部队为止的态度并未得到所有人的欢迎。外交内幕人士批评这种立场过于明确和僵化，取消了任何政治操作的机会，并使法国和德国抵抗组织在道德上感到疲惫。

text: Wartime Rationing
translation: 战时配给制

text: ..........USE IT UP - WEAR IT OUT - MAKE IT DO..........<cr>Because of the rubber shortage and military requirements for leather, on February 9, 1943, shoe rationing went into effect in the United States. Each man, woman and child could purchase up to 3 pairs of shoes per year, using designated stamps in War Ration Books. text: Heroes of Telemark
translation: 特勒马克英雄

text: The 'Norwegian heavy water sabotage' was a series of operations undertaken by Norwegian saboteurs during the war to prevent the Germans from aquiring heavy water (deuterium oxide), which could have been used to produce an atomic bomb. In 1934, at Vermork, Norway, the first commercial plant capable of producing heavy water was built. In April of 1940, the existing supply of heavy water was removed from the plant facilities, and sent to France. However, after occupying Norway, the Germans began using the facility to produce more heavy water for their weapons program.<cr>Between 1940 and 1944, the Norwegian resistance movement conducted a series of actions (including Allied bombing) to destroy the plant and its supply of heavy water. Three operations, code named Grouse, Freshman and Gunnerside, were carried out on the plant's power station at Telemark. Operations Grouse and Freshman failed.<cr>On February 28, 1943, in Operation Gunnerside, Norwegian commandos succeeded in destroying the production facility. Explosive charges destroyed the heavy water electrolysis chambers. During the placement of the charges, the demolition party purposely left a Thompson submachine gun behind to indicate this was the work of British forces and not of the local resistance. Gunnerside was later evaluated by the SOE (British Special Operations Executive) to be the most successful act of sabotage during the war.<cr>In 1944, the Norwegian resistance forces sank the ferry carrying the remaining heavy water to Germany.
translation: 挪威重水破坏行动是一系列由挪威破坏者在战争期间进行的行动，旨在阻止德国获取可用来制造原子弹的重水。1934年，在挪威的维默克建立了世界上第一个能够生产重水的商业工厂。1940年4月，现有的重水供应被移出工厂设施，并送往法国。然而，在占领挪威之后，德军开始利用该设施为他们的武器计划生产更多的重水。<cr>从1940年到1944年，挪威抵抗运动进行了一系列行动（包括盟军轰炸），以摧毁该厂及其重水供应。代号为松鸡、新鲜人和枪手边的三次行动在泰勒马克的发电站实施。松鸡和新鲜人的行动失败了。<cr>1943年2月28日，在代号为枪手边的行动中，挪威突击队成功摧毁了生产设施。爆炸物炸毁了重水电解室。放置炸弹时，破坏小组故意留下了一把汤普森冲锋枪，以表明这是英国军队而非当地抵抗组织所为。后来，枪手边行动被英国特别作战执行局评估为战争期间最成功的破坏行动。<cr>1944年，挪威抵抗力量炸沉了载有剩余重水前往德国的渡轮。

text: The Sea Wolves
translation: 海上狼群

text: Since the early days of the war, the German freighter Ehrenfels, along with her sister ships Drachenfels and Braunfels, lay interned in Marmagoa, the harbor of Porturgese Goa. Portugal was neutral during the war. Concealed aboard the Ehrenfels was a powerful radio transmitter the Germans were using to control U-boat attacks upon Allied shipping in the Arabian Sea and Indian Ocean. In the first part of March 1943, 12 Allied ships had been sunk.<cr>Aware of the German activity, the British SOE (Special Operations Executive) organized a force of reservists to carry out a daring raid on the Ehrenfels. It was kept covert, to avoid the political ramifications of violating Portuguese neutrality in Goa. The operation was not revealed until 35 years afterwards, in 1978.<cr>Members of the Calcutta Light Horse and Calcutta Scottish embarked on the barge Phoebe at Calcutta and sailed around India to Goa. The Phoebe, blacked out, her only marking a handmade Jolly Roger flag at her stern, chugged into the harbor right up to the side of Ehrenfels. A boarding party overcame the German crew and smashed the radio equipment into useless scrap metal. The original plan of sailing Ehrenfels back to Calcutta came to an abrupt end when it was discovered the engines had been disabled. So the ship was scuttled.<cr>After the attack, as part of the cover up, British intelligence dispatched a message over the air falsely warning that the British would invade Goa. The Germans scuttled their two remaining ships.
translation: 自战争初期，德国货船Ehrenfels与其姊妹舰Drachenfels和Braunfels一直被扣留在葡萄牙果阿的马尔加奥港。葡萄牙在战争期间保持中立。Ehrenfels上隐藏着一台强大的无线电发射器，德军利用它来指挥阿拉伯海和印度洋中的潜艇对盟国船只发动攻击。1943年3月初，已有12艘盟军船只被击沉。<cr>英国SOE（特别行动处）得知德国的活动后，组织了一支预备役部队进行一次大胆袭击Ehrenfels的任务。该行动保持秘密，以避免违反果阿地区葡萄牙中立地位的政治后果。直到35年后，即1978年，这项任务才被公开。<cr><cr>加尔各答轻骑兵和加尔各答苏格兰团的成员从加尔各答登上驳船Phoebe，并绕印度航行至果阿。Phoebe漆黑一片，唯一的标记是其尾部悬挂的手制骷髅旗。它缓缓驶入港口，停靠在Ehrenfels旁边。登船小组制服了德军船员并摧毁了无线电设备。<cr>原计划将Ehrenfels拖回加尔各答，但发现引擎已被<cr>失能后，该计划突然终止。于是这艘船被凿沉。<cr><cr>袭击之后，作为掩盖行动的一部分，英国情报部门通过无线电发送了一条虚假警告：英军将入侵果阿。德军随后凿沉了剩下的两艘船只。

text: The Hedgehog and U-954
translation: 刺猬行动与U-954潜艇

text: The Hedgehog was a forward-throwing anti-submarine weapon used during the Battle of the Atlantic. Developed by the British Royal Navy, it fired up to 24 spigot mortars ahead of a ship when attacking a U-boat. It was deployed on convoy escort warships to supplement the depth charges. As the mortar projectiles employed contact fuzes rather than time or barometric (depth) fuzes, detonation occurred directly against a hard surface such as a submarine hull making it more deadly than depth charges.<cr>On May 11 1943, Convoy SC 130, comprising 37 ships, left Nova Scotia bound for North West England. Ranged against the convoy were 25 U-boats in three patrol lines. Several of the U-boats engaged the convoy and its escorts. British long-range aircraft also attacked the U-boats.<cr>During the action on May 19th and 20th, U-954 was sunk by hedgehog attacks from warships HMS Sennen and HMS Jed. German Admiral Karl Doenitz's son Peter Doenitz was among those lost aboard U-954.<cr>No convoy ships were lost. 3 U-boats were sunk and 4 more were damaged. This was a major blow which contributed to Admiral Doenitz's decision to abandon the assault on the North Atlantic convoy route, a turning point in the Battle of the Atlantic.<cr>Note Picture: Hedgehog attack against U-853 in 1945.
translation:
刺猬是一种前投式反潜武器，在大西洋海战中使用。该武器由英国皇家海军开发，当攻击潜艇时，可向前发射多达24枚刺杆迫击炮弹。它被部署在护航驱逐舰上以补充深水炸弹的威力。由于迫击炮弹采用接触引信而非定时或气压（深度）引信，因此爆炸会直接发生在硬表面如潜艇外壳上，使其比深水炸弹更具杀伤力。

1943年5月11日，由37艘船只组成的SC 130船队从新斯科舍出发前往英格兰西北部。25艘德国潜艇在三条巡逻线上对准了该船队，并且其中几艘潜艇与船队及其护航舰展开了交战。英国远程飞机也攻击了这些潜艇。

在5月19日和20日的战斗中，U-954被HMS森恩号和HMS杰德号的刺猬武器击沉。德国海军上将卡尔·邓尼茨的儿子彼得·邓尼茨也在U-954上丧生。

没有船队船只损失。3艘潜艇被击沉，另有4艘受损。这是对邓尼茨上将放弃北大西洋护航航线突击行动决定的重大打击，成为大西洋海战的一个转折点。

translation: 苏联空军重组

text: Due to high losses, the VVS will be forced to scale back and reorganize its air force starting in mid-January. Many air divisions will be disbanded. Eventualy all of the mixed divisions (SAD) will either be disbanded or converted into other types of divisions. Beginning in late April, new air divisions, including the new assault divisions (ShAD) will be formed. So the number of air divisions available will fall over the next 4 months, before recovering to ever larger numbers during the rest of the war.
translation: 由于高损失，从1月中旬开始，苏联空军将被迫缩减并重组其力量。许多航空兵师将被解散。最终所有混合航空兵师（SAD）要么被解散，要么转为其他类型的部队。自4月下旬起，新的航空兵师，包括新型突击航空兵师（ShAD），将陆续组建。因此接下来的四个月内可用的航空兵师数量将会减少，在战争剩余时间里则会逐渐恢复并增加到更大规模。

text: The Western Allies launched Operation Cobra with a concentrated aerial bombardment from thousands of Allied aircraft. Units of the US First Army led the assault. Cobra transformed the high-intensity infantry combat of Normandy into rapid maneuver warfare.

突破卡西诺防线并与安济奥滩头会合后，西方盟军解放了罗马。美国第5集团军和英国第8集团军继续向北推进。盟军占领拉齐奥地区。

- 翁布里亚地区被盟军占领
- 马尔凯地区被盟军占领

text: Allies capture Cherbourg and isolate the Channel Islands region. Germans occupying the islands did not surrender till after the war. <cr><cr>- Channel Islands region controlled by Allies

text: Allies capture Le Havre. Operation Astonia was the codename for the Allied attack on the German-held Channel port of Le Havre. The city had been declared a Festung (fortress) by Hitler. The Allied objective was to secure the harbour facilities intact, to deliver supplies to the Allied armies in Continental Europe. The land attack was carried out by British and Canadian troops, and the German garrison of about 11,000 men surrendered. The port was badly damaged but it was re-opened four weeks later. <cr><cr>- Upper Normandy region captured by Allies
translation: 盟军占领勒阿弗尔。代号为“奥斯特尼亚行动”的盟军攻击目标是夺取德国控制的英吉利海峡港口城市勒阿弗尔。希特勒已将该城宣布为要塞（堡垒）。盟军的目标是确保港口设施完好无损，以便向在欧洲大陆作战的盟军输送补给。地面进攻由英加军队执行，德方守备部队约1.1万人投降。港口遭到严重破坏，但四周后重新开放。<cr>上诺曼底地区被盟军占领

text: Allies capture Picardy, Champagne, Lorraine, Alsace and Luxembourg regions. Patton's Third Army captures Reims and Chalons, then Verdun, St.-Mihiel, and Commercy two days later. One week later it establishes a bridgehead over the Moselle River south of Metz. The US First Army takes the capital city of Luxembourg three days later.<cr><cr>- WA capture Picardy, Champagne, Lorraine, Alsace and Luxembourg regions
translation: 盟军占领了皮卡第、香槟、洛林、阿尔萨斯和卢森堡地区。巴顿的第三集团军攻占兰斯和沙隆，两天后又攻克凡尔登、圣米歇尔和康默西。一周后，在梅斯以南建立了跨越默兹河的桥头堡。三天后，美军第一集团军占领了卢森堡首都。<cr><cr>- 德国占领皮卡第、香槟、洛林、阿尔萨斯和卢森堡地区

translation: 盟军占领勒芒并确保了法国卢瓦尔地区的安全

translation: 盟军占领巴黎并控制了法兰西岛地区。在解放巴黎的战斗中，法国抵抗组织成员与德军展开激战。这张女战士辛明·塞古安的照片成为了女性参与抵抗运动的象征。<cr>- 法兰西岛被盟军夺取

text: After Soviet forces cross the Bulgarian-Rumanian border, the pro Axis government is overthrown by army units together with Fatherland Front detachments after capturing key locations in Sophia such as various ministries, the post, the telegraph, the radio and the railway station. War is declared on Germany and its allies and an armistice is signed with Allies in Moscow. Three Bulgarian armies (numbering 340,000 men) begin mobilizing and preparing to move into Yugoslavia and Macedonia with the task of blocking German forces retreating from Greece. <cr><cr>- Bulgaria Surrenders<cr>- Soviet Union takes control of Bulgaria and Thrace regions

translation: 游击队经过20天的战斗解放了地拉那，同时来自保加利亚和苏联联军在东部 flank 的压力不断增大，德军从阿尔巴尼亚撤出并开始撤退至南斯拉夫。解放完成于地拉那陷落后的两周，共产党接管政权。<cr>指挥官报告：<cr><cr>- 阿尔巴尼亚地区受苏联控制
