Many Luftwaffe and naval personnel are quickly transferred to the ground forces, while additional men are called up for military duty. This manpower is insufficiently trained in ground combat operations.<cr><cr>- 200,000 men are added to the German manpower pool<cr>- The German manpower multiplier is increased by 4<cr>- German Ground National Morale is reduced by 5
translation: 在诺曼底战役中损失了数十万士兵，并且面临盟军横扫法国的威胁，德国下令全面动员可用的人力资源。许多空军和海军人员被迅速调往地面部队，同时还有更多人被征召入伍。这些人对地面作战操作训练不足。<cr>效果：- 向德国防御人力池增加200,000名士兵<cr>- 德国可动员人力倍数增加4<cr>- 德国地面国民士气降低5

text: Ongoing heavy losses in the east, and realization that the war would not end anytime soon, force steps to make more men available for the ground forces. Luftwaffe and Kriegsmarine manpower are shifted to the ground forces. Additional men are freed up from industry.<cr><cr>- The German manpower multiplier is increased by 12.
translation: 东线持续的重大损失，以及战争不会很快结束的现实，迫使采取措施使更多人员可供地面部队使用。空军和海军的人力被转移到地面部队。工业中释放出额外人员。<cr>德国人力倍数增加12。

text: Allies land in Normandy. Italy is no longer the site of the only major ground combat in Western Europe.<cr><cr>- Western Europe TB ground combat intensity increases to VERY HIGH (5) <cr>- Western Europe TB air combat intensity increases to VERY HIGH (5)<cr>- Italy Ground Requirement decreases to 195, Air to 7
translation:
盟军在诺曼底登陆。意大利不再是西欧唯一主要地面战场。
- 西欧地面战斗强度增加至非常高（5）
- 西欧空中战斗强度增加至非常高（5）
- 意大利地面需求减少到195，空中需求减少到7

text: Having broken the German line in Normandy, the Allies form the Falaise pocket and then race across France. The Allies take the Channel ports, central and eastern France. Allies invade southern France. <cr><cr>- Roughly 20% of German ground forces in the Western Europe TB surrender<cr>- Western Europe TB ground combat intensity decreased to HIGH (4)<cr>- Western Europe Ground Requirement decreases to 550<cr>- Norway Ground Requirement decreases to 75<cr>- Balkans Ground Requirement decreases to 130
translation: 在诺曼底突破了德国防线后，盟军形成了法莱斯包围圈，并迅速横扫法国。盟军占领了海峡港口、中东部法国，并入侵了南法。<cr><cr>约20%的驻西欧德军投降<cr><cr>西欧战区地面战斗强度降至高（4）<cr><cr>西欧战区地面需求减少至550<cr><cr>挪威地面需求减少至75<cr><cr>巴尔干地区地面需求减少至130

text: The German offensive in the Ardennes is halted short of the Meuse River. The offensive is called off and German forces retreat back to the German frontier.<cr><cr>- Western Europe ground combat intensity set to HIGH (4)
translation: 德国在阿登地区的进攻在距离默兹河不远处受阻，攻势被取消，德军撤退至德国边境。<cr><cr>- 西欧地面战斗强度设为高（4）

text: After pushing the Germans back to their Ardennes Offensive start lines, Allied armies begin the final offensive to breach the Rhine and overrun Western Germany.<cr><cr>- Western Europe ground combat intensity is set to VERY HIGH (5)
translation: 在将德国军队推回到他们在阿登攻势开始时的位置后，盟军开始了最后的进攻，以突破莱茵河并占领西德。<cr>指挥官报告：西欧地面战斗强度设置为非常高（5）

text: German security forces begin to clash with Soviet partisans, beginning a several year campaign to secure the German rear area.<cr><cr>- Soviet Union Garrison TB ground combat set to VERY LOW (1)
translation: 德国治安部队开始与苏联游击队发生冲突，开始了几年的战役以确保德国后方的安全。<cr><cr>- 苏联守备部队地面战斗强度设为非常低（1）

text: By May 30, 1942, the Partisan Movement becomes centrally controlled and supplied by Stavka. More than 2,000 partisan detachments (over 90,000 personnel) are now under Soviet control. Highly coordinated partisan activity escalates. <cr><cr>- Soviet Union Garrison TB ground combat increases to LOW (2)
translation: 到1942年5月30日，游击队运动开始由最高统帅部大本营中央控制和供应。超过2,000个游击小组（共计超过9万人）现在处于苏联的掌控之下。高度协调的游击活动升级。<cr><cr>- 苏联守备部队地面战斗强度增加至低级(2)

text: With the bulk of the Soviet Union liberated, the Partisan Movement comes to an end. Many of the partisan formations are obsorbed into the Soviet army. <cr><cr>- Soviet Union Garrison TB is now inactive.<cr>- Axis forces in the Soviet Union Garrison TB moved to the Axis Reserve<cr>- Game Event Soviet Partisans is set to Inactive
translation: 随着苏联大部分领土获得解放，游击运动宣告结束。许多游击队部队被并入苏军。<cr>- 苏联守备编制 TB 现已失效。<cr>- 苏联守备编制中的轴心国部队转移到轴心国预备队<cr>- 游击队事件设为不活跃状态<cr>

text: Temporary measures taken to make more men available for the ground forces are ended.<cr><cr>- The German manpower multiplier is reduced by 12.
translation: 临时措施结束，这些措施是为了让更多的人员可以供地面部队使用。<cr> <cr> - 德国的人力倍增器减少12点。

text: In preparation for launching a winter counterattack, Soviets begin forming Cavalry Corps and build additional ski forces. <cr><cr>- Soviets gain 200 AP
translation: 为发动冬季反攻，苏联开始组建骑兵军并加强滑雪部队。<cr><cr> - 苏联获得200行政点

text: Soviets reorganize and begin forming new Rifle Corps.<cr><cr>- Soviets gain 300 AP
translation: 苏军重组并开始组建新的步兵军。<cr><cr>- 苏联获得300行政点

text: Soviet restructure tank forces and begin to form Tank Corps. <cr><cr>Soviets gain 250 AP
translation: 苏联重组坦克部队并开始组建坦克军。<cr><cr> 苏联获得250行政点

text: Soviets create a new combined arms unit, the Mechanized Corps.<cr><cr>Soviets gain 250 AP
translation: 苏联创建了一个新的诸兵种合成部队，机械化军。<cr><cr> 苏联获得250行政点

text: Soviets invent a fearsome new formation, the Artillery Division, and continue army reorganization in order to prepare for a fall/winter counteroffensive.<cr><cr>Soviets gain 200 AP
translation: 苏联发明了一种可怕的新型编制——炮兵师，并继续进行集团军重组，以准备秋季/冬季反攻。<cr><cr> 苏联获得 200 行政点

text: In anticipation of going over to strategic offensive in the summer of 1943, the Soviets continue to reorganize and upgrade their army.<cr><cr>Soviets gain 300 AP
translation: 为了在1943年夏季转入战略性进攻，苏联继续重组和升级其军队。<cr><cr> 苏联获得300行政点

text: With the struggle unending, and Axis armies poised to continue their movement east, the Soviet Union reacts with a massive mobilization and training of manpower. Additional manpower reserves are rushed into action to increase the forces facing the Axis juggernaut.<cr><cr> - 450,000 men added to the Soviet Manpower pool
translation: 随着战斗持续不断，轴心国军队准备继续向东推进，苏联作出反应，进行大规模动员和训练。额外的人力资源被迅速投入行动，以增强对抗轴心国巨无霸的力量。<cr>- 增加450,000人进入苏联人力资源池

text: By early spring of 1942, larger size raids (1,000 bombers per raid) start being conducted over Germany and other Axis territory. During this year, bombing strategies and tactics start evolving, including changes such as the Area Bombing Directive, the Bomber Stream and the Master Bomber tactic. An increasing amount of new bombing systems, ordinance and aircraft are incorporated into the bombing campaign. Among those are the Gee radio navigation system, the 8,000 lb Blockbuster bomb and B-17 aircraft. <cr><cr>- Target: Manpower <cr>- Damage 40, Radius 50, Raids 1
translation: 1942年早春，规模更大的空袭（每次袭击使用1000架轰炸机）开始在德国和其他轴心国领土上进行。这一年中，轰炸策略和战术开始演变，包括区域轰炸指令、轰炸机编队和主轰炸机战术等变化。越来越多的新轰炸系统、弹药和飞机被纳入轰炸行动。其中包括Gee无线电导航系统、8000磅的Blockbuster炸弹和B-17飞机。<cr>目标：人力<cr>破坏：40，半径50，袭击次数1

text: The US 8th Air Force conducts multiple large bomber raids against Axis railyards and heavy industry areas. These raids involve around 300 to 400 bombers. The most significant of them is the 5 month long bombing campaign of the German Ruhr industry complex. The effect of this campaign is a servere reduction in the production output of steel and armaments. <cr><cr>- Target: Railyard <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 40, Raids 1 <cr><cr>- Target: Heavy Industry <cr>- Damage 50, Radius 40, Raids 1
translation:
美国第8航空队对轴心国的铁路枢纽和重工业区进行了多次大规模轰炸。这些行动涉及大约300到400架轰炸机，其中最显著的是针对德国鲁尔工业区长达5个月的空袭。此次战役导致钢铁和武器生产的严重下降。
- 目标：铁路枢纽 <cr>
- 损失：100%，半径：40，袭击次数：1
- 目标：重工业区 <cr>
- 损失：50%，半径：40，袭击次数：1

text: During the 2nd half of 1943 the US 8th AF continues its massive 1,000 bomber raids on German industries. Most significant are the August to December raids on the German aircraft industry. 5,092 tons of explosives are dropped on 14 targeted aircraft plants (mostly airframe plants). Prodution of single-engine fighters (ME 109s and FW 190s) drops by 45%.<cr>The Americans take heavy losses in their raid in August against Regensburg and Schweinfurt, losing 60 planes and 664 crewmen KIA or POW. A later attack of the ball bearing plants around Schweinfurt in October also causes heavy losses, with the Americans losing 60 aircraft with 600 crewmen KIA or POW. These losses amount to 25% of the attacking force. <cr><cr>- Target: Heavy Industry <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 55, Raids 1 <cr><cr>- Target: Airframe <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 50, Raids 1 <cr><cr>- Target: Railyard <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 50, Raids 1
translation: 在1943年下半年，美国第8航空队继续对德国工业进行大规模的千架轰炸机空袭。其中最重要的是从八月到十二月针对德国飞机制造业的一系列袭击。共投下了5,092吨炸弹，目标是14家主要生产机身的飞机工厂。单引擎战斗机（Me 109和Fw 190）的产量下降了45%。<cr>在八月份对雷根斯堡和施韦因富特的袭击中，美国损失惨重，共有60架飞机被击落或俘获，664名机组人员阵亡或成为战俘。十月针对施韦因富特周边滚珠轴承工厂的一次攻击也造成了重大损失，美军损失了60架飞机和600名机组人员（阵亡或成为战俘）。这些损失占到了袭击部队的25%。<cr><cr>- 目标：重工业 <cr>- 损坏程度：100%，半径：55，空袭次数：1 <cr><cr>- 目标：飞机机身厂 <cr>- 损坏程度：100%，半径：50，空袭次数：1 <cr><cr>- 目标：铁路枢纽 <cr>- 损坏程度：100%，半径：50，空袭次数：1

text: From airfields in Libya, The American 9th AF conducts bombing raids on the Ploesti oil fields and refineries in Rumania as part of Operation Tidal Wave with the goal of denying petroleum-based fuel to the Axis powers. The Americans lose 53 aircraft and 660 air crewmen in the operation, one of the costliest major Allied air raids of the war. The mission fails to curtail fuel production output. <cr><cr>- Target: Oil <cr>- Damage 50, Radius 115, Raids 1 <cr><cr>- Target: Fuel <cr>- Damage 50, Radius 115, Raids 1 <cr><cr>- Target: Railyard <cr>- Damage 50, Radius 115, Raids 1
translation: 从利比亚的机场出发，美国第9航空队执行代号为“浪潮”的行动，对罗马尼亚的普洛耶什蒂油田和炼油厂进行轰炸，旨在切断轴心国获取石油基燃料的途径。此次行动中，美军损失了53架飞机和660名空勤人员，成为盟军在战争中最昂贵的重大空中袭击之一。任务未能遏制燃油产量。<cr>目标：油田<cr>- 损伤 50，半径 115，袭击次数 1<cr>目标：燃料<cr>- 损伤 50，半径 115，袭击次数 1<cr>目标：铁路枢纽<cr>- 损伤 50，半径 115，袭击次数 1

text: The 8th AF intensifies its bombing campaign against the German oil industry and its distribution, concentrating on synthetic oil refineries. <cr><cr>- Target: Synthetic Fuel <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 60, Raids 2 <cr><cr>- Target: Railyard <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 50, Raids 1
translation:
第8航空队加强对德国石油工业及其分配的轰炸，集中于合成燃料炼油厂。
<cr><cr>- 目标：合成燃料 <cr>- 损坏率100%，影响半径60公里，空袭次数2
<cr><cr>- 目标：火车站 <cr>- 损坏率100%，影响半径50公里，空袭次数1

text: During early 1944, 15th AF continues its hammering on the German oil industry. <cr><cr>- Target: Fuel <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 65, Raids 1 <cr><cr>- Target: Railyard <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 65, Raids 1
translation: 1944年初，第15航空队继续打击德国的石油工业。<cr><cr>- 目标：燃料 <cr>- 损坏率100%，半径65公里，空袭次数1 <cr><cr>- 目标：铁路枢纽 <cr>- 损坏率100%，半径65公里，空袭次数1

text: During the 2nd half of 1944, the 15th AF's continuous attacks on German oil and fuel industry begin having a major effect upon German military operations. <cr><cr>- Target: Synthetic Fuel <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 85, Raids 1 <cr><cr>- Target: Fuel <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 80, Raids 1 <cr><cr>- Target: Railyard <cr>- Damage 100, Radius 80, Raids 1
translation: 在1944年下半年，第15航空队对德国石油和燃料工业的连续攻击开始对德军作战产生重大影响。<cr><cr>- 目标：合成燃料 <cr>- 损坏 100，半径 85，袭击次数 1 <cr><cr>- 目标：燃料 <cr>- 损坏 100，半径 80，袭击次数 1 <cr><cr>- 目标：铁路枢纽 <cr>- 损坏 100，半径 80，袭击次数 1

text: First American daylight raids on occupied Europe begin in June of 1942. German air defenses increased in July to combat the growing intensity of the allied bombing campaign. <cr><cr>- Western Europe Air Defense Requirement increases to 85<cr>- Night Air Defense Requirement increases to 59
translation: 1942年6月，美军开始在被占领的欧洲进行白天空袭。德国防空力量于7月增强，以应对盟军轰炸强度的增长。<cr>西部欧洲防空需求增加至85<cr>夜间防空需求增加至59

text: Allied short-to-medium range fighters (P-47s) begin escorting bomber groups on raids over occupied Europe. Presence of allied escort fighters forces Germany to expand its air defenses.<cr><cr>- Western Europe Air Defense Requirement increases to 150<cr>- Night Air Defense Requirement increases to 80
translation:
盟军的中短程战斗机（P-47）开始护航轰炸机编队对占领下的欧洲进行空袭。盟军护航战斗机的存在迫使德国扩大其防空力量。
- 西欧防空需求增加至150
- 夜间防空需求增加至80

text: The RAF's 'Battle of Berlin' campaign begins in the latter part of 1943 and continues into the spring of 1944. The campaign targets other german cities as well, to prevent the concentration of defenses in Berlin. Germany is forced to increase its air defenses. <cr><cr>- Western Europe Air Defense Requirement increases to 200<cr>- Night Air Defense Requirement increases to 95
translation: 英国皇家空军的“柏林战役”于1943年下半年开始，并持续到1944年春天。该行动还针对其他德国城市，以防止柏林集中防御力量。德国被迫加强其防空力量。<cr>西欧防空需求增加至200<cr>夜间防空需求增加至95

text: Spring of 1944 introduces new long range fighters (P-51s) which are able to escort bomber groups all the way to their targets and back. The new fighters are powerful enough to engage the best of the Luftwaffe air forces. By mid-year, Germany reorganizes its Luftwaffe forces and ground air defenses to meet the new threat. <cr><cr>- Western Europe Air Defense Requirement increases to 270<cr>- Western Europe Night Air Defense Requirement decreses to 75
translation: Spring of 1944 introduces new long range fighters (P-51s) which are able to escort bomber groups all the way to their targets and back. The new fighters are powerful enough to engage the best of the Luftwaffe air forces. By mid-year, Germany reorganizes its Luftwaffe forces and ground air defenses to meet the new threat. <cr><cr>- Western Europe Air Defense Requirement increases to 270<cr>- Western Europe Night Air Defense Requirement decreses to 75

text: Germany desperately tries to gain air superiority with their diminishing air forces by conducting air campaigns like Operation Bodenplatte (Baseplate), during the stagnant stage of the Battle of the Bulge. <cr><cr>- Western Europe Air Defense Requirement increases to 300
translation: 德国竭力通过执行“大地平板”等空中行动来获得制空权，此时正值突出部战役的僵持阶段。<cr><cr>- 西欧防空需求增加至300

text: Facing harsh winter conditions in the Soviet Union, forces are freed up in the west. However, increasing partisan activities require additional rear area security.<cr><cr>- Western Europe Ground Requirement decreases to 345<cr>- Soviet Union Garrison Ground Requirement increases to 90
translation:
面对苏联严酷的冬季条件，西部地区可以释放部分兵力。然而，游击活动日益增加，需要加强后方地区的治安。
<cr><cr>- 西欧地面需求减少至345<cr>- 苏联守备部队地面需求增加至90

text: In the wake of the Dieppe Raid, additional forces are required to face the threat in the West.<cr><cr>- Western Europe Ground Requirement increases to 475
translation: 在迪耶普突袭之后，需要增派部队以应对西线威胁。<cr>西欧地面需求增加至475

text: With the fall of North Africa, the Axis prepare for the next Allied move.<cr><cr>- Western Europe Ground Requirement increases to 530<cr>- Italy Ground Requirement increases to 230, Air to 70<cr>- Balkans Ground Requirement increases to 160, Air to 11
translation:
随着北非沦陷，轴心国准备应对盟军的下一步行动。
- 西欧地面需求增加至530
- 意大利地面需求增加至230，空中需求增至70
- 巴尔干半岛地面需求增加至160，空中需求增至11

text: With an Allied invasion of France imminent, Germany reinforces the Atlantic Wall in the West.<cr><cr>- Western Europe Ground Requirement increases to 570
translation: 随着盟军即将入侵法国，德国加强了西欧的“大西洋壁垒”。<cr><cr>- 西欧地面需求增加到570

text: With Axis forces 60 miles from Alexandria, the desire to reach Cairo intensifies.<cr><cr>- North Africa Ground Requirement increases to 85
translation: 随着轴心国部队距离亚历山大港仅60英里，进军开罗的欲望愈发强烈。<cr>北非地面需求增加至85

text: British carry out commando raids in Norway, including attack on atomic heavy water factilities. Norwegian resistance increases.<cr><cr>- Norway Ground Requirement increases to 95, Naval decreases to 17
translation: 英军在挪威展开突击队袭击，包括对重水设施的攻击。挪威抵抗运动增强。<cr>地面需求增加至95，海军需求减少至17

text: With Finland out of the war, Northern Norway becomes part of the frontline.<cr><cr>- Norway Air Requirement increases to 15
translation: 芬兰退出战争后，北部挪威成为前线的一部分。<cr><cr>- 挪威空军需求增加至15

text: Although a secondary front, periodic Soviet offensives force the Finns to strengthen their defenses and remain vigilent.<cr><cr>- Finland Ground Requirement increases to 245, Air to 14
translation: 尽管是次要战线，苏联的周期性攻势迫使芬兰加强防御并保持警惕。<cr><cr>- 芬兰地面需求增加到245，空中需求增加到14

text: Finland calls for a strengthening of it's defenses.<cr><cr>- Finland Ground Requirement increases to 260
translation: 芬兰呼吁加强其防御。<cr><cr>- 芬兰地面需求增加到260

text: Security units fan out into occupied territories.<cr><cr>- Soviet Union Garrison Ground Requirement increases to 60
translation: 治安单位分散到被占领地区。<cr>-苏联守备地面需求增加至60

text: Declaring war on the United States after Pearl Harbor, Germany finds it now faces the possiblity of increasing enemy action in many areas.<cr><cr>- Western Europe Air Requirement increases to 73, Night Air to 39<cr>- Italy Ground Requirement increases to 68, Air to 35<cr>- North Africa Ground Requirement increases to 70, Air to 28, Naval to 7<cr>- Norway Ground Requirement increases to 82, Air to 8, Naval to 24<cr>- Finland Ground Requirement increases to 225
translation: 对美国宣战后，德国发现自己现在面临着许多地区的敌方行动可能增加的问题。<cr>西欧空军需求增至73，夜间空军需求增至39<cr>意大利地面部队需求增至68，空军需求增至35<cr>北非地面部队需求增至70，空军需求增至28，海军需求增至7<cr>挪威地面部队需求增至82，空军需求增至8，海军需求增至24<cr>芬兰地面部队需求增至225

text: Facing increasing partisan activity, German security divisions are enlarged.<cr><cr>- Soviet Union Garrison Ground Requirement increases to 140
translation: 面对日益增长的游击队活动，德国治安师扩编。<cr><cr>- 苏联守备部队地面需求增加至140

text: The Balkans require an ever increasing garrison.<cr><cr>- Balkans Ground Requirement increases to 135, Air to 6
translation: 巴尔干地区需要不断增加守备部队。<cr>- 巴尔干地面需求增加到135，空中需求增加到6

text: On May 14 1942 the Mexican tanker Potrero del Llano is sunk by U-564. The tanker was sailing unescorted from Tampico to New York City with 6,132 tons of petroleum. She was sighted by U-564 while east of the coast of US Florida. The German commander noticed an illuminated flag painted on the side of the ship, but misidentified it as the Italian flag. Since only ships of the Mexican Navy were permitted to display the Mexican flag with the eagle in the center, the flag shown by the Potrero del Llano resembled the Italian one. Having decided the tanker's position and course meant that she could not be Italian, U-564 sank her, with the loss of 13 of her crew.<cr>Up to this point Mexico had remained neutral. On May 21st, the Mexican Foreign Office reported that Germany refused to accept Mexico's protest against the sinking of the tanker. The following day, the Mexican governemnt announced its first ever declaration of war.<cr>All of North America is now involved in the fight against the Axis Powers.<cr>Note Picture: The Potrero del Llano burns close to the Florida coast, after being torpedoed.
translation: 1942年5月14日，墨西哥油轮Potrero del Llano被U-564潜艇击沉。该油轮正从坦皮科前往纽约市，载有6,132吨石油，并且未得到护航。<cr>德国指挥官注意到船侧有一面点亮的旗帜，但误将其识别为意大利国旗。<cr>由于只有墨西哥海军被允许展示中间带有鹰徽的墨西哥国旗，Potrero del Llano上展示的旗帜与意大利国旗相似。<cr>鉴于油轮的位置和航线不可能是意大利船只，U-564潜艇击沉了它，并导致13名船员丧生。<cr>截至此时，墨西哥一直保持中立。<cr>5月21日，墨西哥外交部报告称德国拒绝接受墨西哥对油轮被击沉的抗议。<cr>次日，墨西哥政府宣布其首次宣战声明。<cr>现在整个北美洲都加入了对抗轴心国势力的战斗。<cr>注意图片：Potrero del Llano在佛罗里达海岸附近燃烧，此前已被鱼雷击中。

text: <cr>The German High Command began planning the invasion of the Soviet Union in July 1940. The operation opened up the Eastern Front, in which more forces were committed than in any other theatre of war in history. The Axis Powers offensive, invading along a 2,900-kilometer (1,800 mi) front, marked an escalation of World War II, both geographically and in the formation of the Allied coalition including the Soviet Union.<cr>Also, in July 1940, the Soviets began developing war plans that evolved over the next several months into two strategic plans. The State Defense Plan 1941 (DP-41) and the Mobilization Plan 1941 (MP-41) called for the deployment of 80% of the available Soviet military forces as the first strategic echelon, in the four military districts of the western Soviet Union that faced the Axis territories. The deployment of the remaining 20% along the Dvina and Dnieper Rivers as the second echelon under Stavka control.<cr>On June 22, 1941, the greatest titanic struggle began.

text: <cr>The Germans have been victoriously advancing eastward into the Soviet Union for three months. But, a primary objective of Barbarossa, Moscow, still lies ahead. With supply lines stretched to the breaking point and their forces exhausted, they prepare for an all out offensive on the Soviet capital. Concentrated under the command of Army Group Center are 3 panzer groups and 3 armies, constituting the bulk of the German mechanized forces.<cr>Facing the Germans are three Soviet fronts forming a defensive line, barring the way to Moscow. Having been involved in heavy fighting, this force is still a formidable concentration of manpower, armor and guns.
translation: 德国人已经在苏联境内向东胜利推进了三个月。但是，巴巴罗萨行动的主要目标莫斯科仍然在前方。补给线已经拉到了极限，部队也已疲惫不堪，他们准备对苏联首都发起全面进攻。中央集团军群指挥下集中了3个装甲集群和3个步兵师，构成了德国机械化部队的主力。<cr><cr>面对德军的是三个形成防御线、阻挡通向莫斯科道路的苏军方面军。尽管已经经历了激烈的战斗，这支部队仍然是人力、装甲和火炮的强大集结。

text: <cr>During the summer and fall of 1942, the Germans and their allies advanced deep into southeastern Russia with the largest territorial gains of their invasion of the USSR. Now, they find themselves dangerously overextended and exhausted. However, the Soviets have been building reserve armies and reinforcing their forces along the Don and Volga. Recognising that the Germans are ill-prepared for continued offensive operations, Stavka has decided to conduct a number of counteroffensive operations around Stalingrad, breaking through the Axis lines, surrounding their enemy and then continuing west.<cr>If their Stalingrad forces are cut off, the Germans will be hard pressed to save them.
translation:
在1942年夏季和秋季，德军及其盟友深入东南俄罗斯境内，取得了入侵苏联以来最大的领土扩张。然而，他们现在发现自己过度延伸且疲惫不堪。不过，苏联一直在组建预备军团，并沿顿河和伏尔加河加强兵力部署。最高统帅部大本营认识到德国人对继续发动攻势准备不足，决定在斯大林格勒周围进行一系列反攻行动，突破轴心国防线，包围敌人并继续向西推进。

如果德军的斯大林格勒部队被切断，他们将很难救援这些部队。

text: <cr>The first half of 1942 has seen a series of Soviet offensives pushing the Germans back from Moscow. As a result, a salient has been formed along the front line in the direction of the capital. In an effort to destroy the German 9th Army, the Soviets plan to launch multiple coordinated thrusts from all sides against the Rzhev-Vyazma Salient. If successful, the attacking armies will link up and advance towards Smolensk, enveloping and destroying the remaining German forces.<cr>The 9th Army has limited forces and reinforcement is unlikely. The defenders plan to stand their ground, creating strong-points in the Salient's towns if the Soviets advance past them, causing problems for the Red Army in their rear areas.

translation:

第9集团军兵力有限，增援的可能性不大。防守方计划坚守阵地，在苏军突破城镇后在这些城镇内建立支撑点，给红军在其后方造成麻烦。

text: <cr>The capture of Leningrad is one of the three strategic goals of Operation Barbarossa and the main target of Army Group North. The German plan calls for capturing the city on the move, with the Fourth Panzer Group advancing to establish a supply line for the following infantry forces that will be needed to assault the city. The mobile forces must then cut the Soviet supply lines into the city, isolating the defenders. The German infantry must concentrate its strength for the assault on the city's fortifications.<cr>The Soviet forces must delay the German advance as long as possible, while constructing fortifications to defend the city and its supply lines.
translation:
